product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (2024) Intel Core Ultra 7 155U 12-Cores w/ Intel® AI Boost NPU & Carbon Fiber Magnesium Chassis & Touch Screen - Black
product_description:
How Do You Show Respect for the Planet?
The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (14ʺ Intel) laptop still uses carbon fiber for the chassis — but better yet some of that carbon fiber is recycled from post-industrial remnants and is used along with 90% recycled magnesium. Plus, the chassis, the battery pack, the speaker enclosure, and the power adapter all include recycled post-consumer content. And we don’t stop there. The packaging is 100% plastic-free and comprised in part with rapid-renewable materials made from bamboo-sugar-cane fiber.
Elevated Performance & Lasting Battery
The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 boasts the world’s first laptop powered by Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, making it ideal for creating and on-the-go productivity. Enjoy optimized performance with workloads pushed to dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) for sustained tasks and resilient battery life. Go ahead, turn on auto-framing or low-light enhancement for your online meetings, even when unplugged! Choose the Intel vPro® Evo™ Edition, for multilayer security, professional-grade performance, reliable stability, and complete management for IT.
Raise the Bar on Collaboration
A Communications Bar, positioned at the top of the display for easy laptop opening, houses two cameras (FHD / infrared (IR)) — or upgrade to the premium 8MP & IR Mobile Industry Processor Interface (MIPI) with Computer Vision — both options include a webcam privacy shutter. Additionally, two 360-degree mics with AI-based noise cancellation, combined with Dolby Voice® and Dolby Atmos® deliver a superb audio experience. Plus, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 is Zoom-certified. Make calls, listen to music, or watch a video and enjoy the sublime sounds.
You Spoke. We Listened: We’ve Redesigned Our Legendary Keyboard
Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard now includes tactile markings to help people with visual impairments more easily find the correct keys. We’ve moved the fingerprint reader to the keyboard, resulting in a larger sensor for a better experience. Plus, our TrackPad is even larger now, at 120mm / 4.72ʺ. Our beloved red TrackPoint still lets you navigate —  but with a double tap, it opens the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
A Feast for the Eyes
Razor-thin bezels frame an optional stunning 14ʺ 2.8K OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate. Sharp, clear details make content pop and colors more vibrant than ever on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop. But perhaps the best part yet? It’s easy on the eyes with Eyesafe® certification, so you can put in the long hours to meet your deadlines and not worry about eye-strain and fatigue.
Engineered for a No-Compromise Experience
The Intel® Evo™ Edition, ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop is engineered to do it all. Experience all-day battery life, instant wake, and best-in-class connectivity. No matter what tasks you tackle, this device is highly responsive. Plus, with Intel® Unison™, you can sync your laptop with any iOS or Android smartphone and then call or text, and even transfer files, photos, and videos all from the convenience of your PC.
Unleash Software Superpowers
Get the most out of your device with preinstalled Lenovo apps. Lenovo View is an AI-based camera app that enhances video quality and provides intelligent collaboration, privacy, and digital wellness features. Lenovo Vantage centralizes settings to safeguard data, automate updates, and improve performance — or Lenovo Commercial Vantage for IT manageability. We make it easier and safer to do your job well.
Stand Tough With Battle-Tested ThinkPad
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Your Face. Your Fingerprint. Your Fortress.
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop, from the fingerprint reader to facial recognition software. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, boasts discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to safeguard critical data with encryption. Plus, AI-powered Intel® Threat Detection Technology helps prevent ransomware, cryptojacking, and more. When it comes to security and protecting your assets, we’ve got you covered

product_description:
The Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi barcode reader is perfectly adapted to crowded points of sale: it has the same scanning speed as a laser scanner, but it has the capture capability of an imager. Truncated (shortened), poorly printed or damaged barcodes are scanned without problems, regardless of the scanning method: by presentation or by swiping. The new electronic platform of the Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi barcode reader offers outstanding performance and easy connection to any POS system through the unique USB 5V connection.
✔ omnidirectional scanner with high performance imager technology;✔ fast decoding of 1D, 2D and Digimarc barcodes;✔ long-term reliability, because it does not contain moving components.
The durability and performance of the vertical scanner Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi are the main assets that this equipment brings to your business from Retail, both in points of sale and for mobile marketing campaigns.
Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi , in version M3410-010210-07104 , scans 1D and 2D barcodes printed on products or presented in electronic format and Digimarc barcodes.
Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi is compatible with previous series, which allows you to use the same accessories (data cables, power supplies, power cables). Another advantage is the fact that it has the same dimensions, so it will be enough to replace a previous model with the new scanner, without the need for changes or reconfiguration of the point of sale.
For configuring and managing Datalogic Magellan scanners, the free Magellan On-Screen Programming application is available.
In the package, together with the Datalogic Magellan 3410VSi imager, the 4.5m serial cable (RS-232), the EU type power cable and the mounting bracket are included. The power supply is ordered separately

The Datalogic QuickScan QBT2500 is a highly reliable omnidirectional 2D imager for the POS in retail, hospitality, healthcare, and light manufacturing. Therefore, it quickly and reliably captures 1D, 2D, postal, and Digimarc barcodes, even from displays and through Plexiglas partitions.
The wide Bluetooth wireless range of up to 100 m provides the maximum freedom of movement. The QBT2500 sends the data via the base station to the host or to any mobile device with a Bluetooth function—even connecting to either Android or iOS via the HID profile. The powerful lithium-ion battery, which is user-replaceable in a few seconds without any tools, ensures long operating times. The QBT2500 is quickly charged, also without the charging station, via the integrated USB-C connector. product_description:
As a member of the TUF Gaming family, the F16 boasts some seriously impressive specs, giving you access to the very best of gaming on Windows 11. Featuring with an Intel Core i7 Processor 14650HX and up to an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, the F16 can easily play the latest games or keep your workflow on schedule.
Get ready for game-changing performance with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU inside our 2025 TUF Gaming F16. Sporting cutting-edge technologies like DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation and Ray Tracing, the F16 delivers incredible experiences in the latest and most graphically intense games.
Keep up with the pros thanks to a 165Hz display. NVIDIA G-SYNC synchronizes the display's refresh rate with the GPU's output to reduce lag, minimize stuttering, and eliminate visual tearing for ultra-smooth and lifelike gameplay. The panel hits 100% of the sRGB color space, reproducing colors exactly as the creator intended. On a 16-inch laptop chassis, this resolution packs an incredible pixel density, ensuring your videos and games are as immersive as possible without sacrificing portability.
Powerful components require powerful cooling, so we’ve equipped the TUF Gaming F16 with a whole suite of technology to keep it running at peak performance. From the 2nd Gen Arc Flow Fans inspired by aircraft engines to a full-width heatsink and integrated dust filters, the F16 will never lose its cool.
In order to earn the TUF Gaming name, these laptops must successfully survive a rigorous battery of MIL-STD-810H tests. Test devices are exposed to drops, vibration, humidity, and extreme temperatures to ensure reliability. Dependable even in the harshest conditions, the F16 is more than capable of withstanding the accidental bumps and knocks of everyday life.
No matter your setup, the TUF Gaming F16 will keep you connected. A dedicated HDMI 2.1 port is supplemented by dual USB Type-C with DisplayPort support, as well as the power and versatility of USB 3.2. Fast and reliable Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) ensures that you'll be able to get online and be productive wherever compatible connections are available, or you can wire up directly with gigabit Ethernet on-board. For added signal stability at long ranges, the F16 also employs TAS technology, giving you more freedom to work and play away from your router.

Geared for serious gaming and rocking a slick new style, TUF Gaming A15 is a feature-packed Windows 11 gaming laptop with the power to carry you to victory. The new GeForce RTX™3050 GPU delivers fluid gameplay on a 144Hz display, while the potent AMD Ryzen™7 CPU is bolstered by improved cooling that amps CPU performance and keeps acoustics stealthy.
A textured honeycomb design on the base adds grip and echoes the hexagon reinforcements around the chassis. Hairline brush strokes accent the palm area, adding a subtle texture that looks professional and clean.
Honeycomb GripTextured honeycomb grip coats the bottom of the chassis. Strategic cuts double as cooling vents.
Smart and StrikingBold Graphite Black and sleek Eclipse Gray tints show off your personality.
Brushed Metal FinishContrasting hairline brushstrokes across the chassis are clean-cut and sleek.
Always ready for action, the TUF Gaming A15 excels at gaming, streaming, and everything in between. Up to an 8-core AMD Ryzen™7 CPU activates as many as 16 threads to fly through multitasking and more. Gameplay graphics are smooth with the GeForce RTX™3050 GPU which reliably delivers high frame rates for a ton of modern games. A superfast NVMe PCIe®SSD 512GB speeds up load times, while an open SSD slot makes it easy to add terabytes more space for all your games.

With Adaptive-Sync, the display's refresh rate synchronizes with the GPU's frame rate to reduce lag, minimize stuttering, and eliminate visual tearing for ultra-smooth and immersive gameplay. Level up your multitasking abilities by connecting a second monitor via the USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C™, which is G-SYNC®enabled and supports DisplayPort™1.4. Our noise-canceling technology runs on the CPU, freeing up the GPU to maximize gaming performance.

product_description:
Powerful performance in a compact format
Inside is the latest Intel® technology: Choose between a 13th generation Intel® Core™ i3 or more powerful Core™ i5 / i7 H-Series CPUs with up to 10 cores and 5.2 GHz boost . 
Supported by DDR5 memory up to 64 GB and two ultra-fast PCIe 4.0 SSDs, the neo 50q offers enough reserves for classic office applications, data analysis, virtual meetings, or digital signage.
Connectivity in a small space
Despite its tiny dimensions, the ThinkCentre neo 50q is surprisingly well equipped:
In front:
1x USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) with charging function
1x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps), always-on
1x 3.5mm headset jack
Rear:
2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps)
2x USB-A 2.0 (one with Smart Power On)
1x HDMI 2.1 (up to 4K @ 60Hz)
1x DisplayPort 1.4b
1x LAN (Gigabit RJ-45)
1x punch-out port (optionally VGA, additional DP, COM port or 2.5GbE)
This allows you to use up to three monitors simultaneously – perfect for efficient multitasking and clear dashboards.
Always connected – even wirelessly
Secure and manageable
With TPM 2.0 , a Kensington® Lock Slot , optional Chassis Intrusion Switch and BIOS functions such as “Smart USB Protection”, the neo 50q is optimally protected against theft and manipulation. 
Administration is straightforward thanks to Non-vPro – ideal for smaller companies and organizations.
Sustainable thinking
Not only small, but also green:
Housing and packaging with up to 90% recycled plastic
Use of ocean-bound plastic
EPEAT Gold , ENERGY STAR 9.0 and TCO 10.0 certified
TÜV Rheinland® Ultra Low Noise – for whisper-quiet operation in the office
Flexible mounting
Whether under the desk, behind the monitor (VESA compatible) or as part of a tiny-in-one setup –> the ThinkCentre neo 50q adapts to your environment. 
Optionally available: Power adapter cage and vertical stand.
Redefining the size of small!

product_description:
Beyond Fast
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built for the era of AI, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the Max-Q suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
Enjoy 3 Months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on Lenovo LOQ
Play Forza Horizon 5, Battlefield V, and hundreds of other PC games on the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 with 3 months of Game Pass, including EA Play. Enjoy iconic franchises like Halo, and many more. Plus, you get free perks, including in-game content, consumables, and more, as well as member discounts of up to 20% off select games in the Game Pass library, and up to 10% off related game add-ons. Gaming at Your Coolest
Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9's revolutionary hyper chamber thermal design is a game-changer. The hyper chamber was purposefully designed for gaming, employing dual fans that spin outward to efficiently expel heat from the back of the device. No more hot air blowing on your hand during a game. The sealed chamber also grants an extra 10W of power (maximum 160W thermal design power), reduces skin temperature by 2°C, and decreases noise by 2dB. Whether in an epic gaming session or a library's quiet zone, enjoy your laptop in cool silence.
Gaming in Vivid Detail
Immerse yourself in rich visuals on the 15.6″ 16:9 display, coupled with 3-side narrow bezels. Stunning   resolution, fast refresh rates, and high brightness ensure a vivid picture. Complete sRGB coverage enhances colors, while NVIDIA® G-SYNC® eliminates screen tearing and stuttering. Advanced Optimus switches between integrated and dedicated graphics to optimize performance, reduce latency, and extend battery life for an unparalleled gaming experience.
Your Key to Winning
With 1.5mm key travel, the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 laptop’s keyboard offers precision and comfort — perfect for gaming and extended typing sessions. Enjoy 100% anti-ghosting for accuracy during intense gameplay. Choose between calming white backlighting or vibrant 4-zone RGB lighting, and personalize it further with swappable keycaps.
Immersive 3D Audio
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries on the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 laptop. Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game experience. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic doesn't just enhance your gaming — it immerses you in it.

product_name: MSI Crosshair 17 HX AI (2025) D2XWGKG NEW Intel Core Ultra 9 Gen II 275HX 24-Cores w/ NVIDIA RTX™ 5070 8GB DDR7 &  2.5K IPS 240Hz Display , Cosmos Gray
product_description:
وسط اتساع الكون الشاسع، ينطلق كشاف شجاع في رحلة ملحمية مسلحًا بجهاز Crosshair 17 HX AI D2XW المدجج بأحدث التقنيات، لاستكشاف المجهول.
مستوى جديد من الأداء مع بنية جديدة تمامًا من نوى P وE، حيث يقدم معالج Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 275HX أداءً محسّنًا لكل واط. هذا المعالج مصمم لجعل تجربة الألعاب المحمولة أكثر برودة وهدوءًا، مع توفير أداء يتسم بالتميز.
*الأداء والطاقة مقارنةً بمعالج Intel® Core™ i9 السابق 14900HX. قد تختلف النتائج حسب السيناريو.
مغير قواعد اللعبة. مدعومة بتقنية NVIDIA Blackwell، توفر بطاقات الرسوميات المحمولة من سلسلة GeForce RTX™ 50 قدرات مغيرة للعبة للاعبين والمبدعين. مزودة بمستوى هائل من قوة الذكاء الاصطناعي، تمكّن سلسلة RTX 50 تجارب جديدة ووضوح رسومي من المستوى التالي. مضاعفة الأداء مع تقنية NVIDIA DLSS 4، وتوليد الصور بسرعة غير مسبوقة، وإطلاق العنان لإبداعك مع NVIDIA Studio. كل ذلك في أرقى وأطول بطاقات RTX المحمولة، المحسّنة بتقنية Max-Q.
تقنية DLSS هي مجموعة ثورية من تقنيات التصوير العصبي التي تستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة معدل الإطارات في الثانية (FPS)، وتقليل زمن الانتظار، وتحسين جودة الصورة. الاختراق الأخير، DLSS 4، يقدم تقنية توليد الإطارات المتعددة الجديدة وتحسين إعادة بناء الأشعة والدقة الفائقة، مدعومًا من بطاقات GeForce RTX™ 50 ونوى Tensor من الجيل الخامس. تعتبر تقنية DLSS على بطاقات GeForce RTX أفضل وسيلة للعب، مدعومة بسوبر كمبيوتر NVIDIA للذكاء الاصطناعي في السحابة، والذي يعمل باستمرار على تحسين قدرات الألعاب على جهاز الكمبيوتر الخاص بك.
اختبر إنتاجية أكثر ذكاءً مع ميزة Copilot ومحرك MSI AI لتمكين تعدد المهام بسلاسة. تتكيف هذه الأدوات المتقدمة بالذكاء الاصطناعي مع احتياجاتك، مما يحسن الأداء ويسهل سير العمل بسهولة.
يتيح التصميم الجديد لنظام التبريد مخرجات هواء متعددة الاتجاهات، مما يؤدي إلى تبريد أكثر كفاءة. بالإضافة إلى تصميم الأنابيب المشتركة الذي يتضمن خمس أنابيب حرارية بين المعالج المركزي (CPU) ووحدة معالجة الرسوميات (GPU)، وأقطار أكبر للأنابيب الحرارية، وزيت حراري حصري من MSI، يمكنك أن تكون مطمئنًا لتحقيق أقصى أداء حتى في ظروف الألعاب القاسية.
مع دعم يصل إلى 2 SSD وسرعات نقل فائقة، توفر سلسلة Crosshair أداءً بيانات استثنائيًا مع قدرات ألعاب وتعدد مهام لا مثيل لها. اختبر أقصى كفاءة لجميع أحمال العمل لديك.
*ستختلف الترددات الفعلية حسب تركيبة الذاكرة وقدرة المعالج المركزي (CPU).
*يتم تحقيق أقصى سرعة باستخدام عدة SSDs في وضع RAID 0، وقد لا تكون مُعدة مسبقًا عند فتح العلبة. قد تختلف السرعات الفعلية حسب التكوين.
اختبر الأضواء المتألقة والنابضة للحياة في لوحة المفاتيح ذات 24 منطقة إضاءة RGB، والتي تتميز بمفاتيح WASD المضيئة وأغطية المفاتيح المصممة بشكل فريد، لتجربة ألعاب ممتعة مليئة بالأناقة!
شاشة QHD+ تقدم وضوحًا مذهلاً، مع معدل تحديث 240 هرتز لحركة سلسة واستجابة فائقة في الألعاب.
*اختياري. قد تختلف المواصفات الفعلية حسب التكوينات.
يدعم شحن PD بقوة 100 واط (20 فولت @ 5 أمبير) أثناء تشغيل النظام (حالة الطاقة S0) ووضع السكون (Modern Standby Low-Power Idle)، و45 واط (20 فولت @ 2.25 أمبير) وحتى 100 واط (20 فولت @ 5 أمبير) في وضع الإسبات (حالة الطاقة S4) والوضع المطفي (حالة الطاقة S5). قد يتأثر أداء النظام العام لتكييف تيار الشحن. تختلف سرعة الشحن حسب حالة النظام والبطارية. يُفضل استخدام شاحن MSI PD لضمان أفضل أداء.
يضيف Crosshair 17 HX AI D2XW غطاء كاميرا الويب، مما يتيح للمستخدمين حجب الكاميرا فعلياً لضمان الخصوصية والحفاظ عليها.
تجربة لاسلكية استثنائية
مع أحدث تقنيات Wi-Fi 6E، استمتع بسرعة فائقة وثبات شبكة لا مثيل له، حتى مع استخدام العديد من الأجهزة في آن واحد.

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad Edge E14 Gen 7 (2025) NEW Intel® Ultra 7 Gen II 255H HIGH Performance 16-Core Intel® AI Boost w/ DDR5 Memory & Backlit keyboard , Black
product_description:
The Unplugged Multitasker
With Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop brings AI-assisted productivity to the forefront. Enjoy optimized performance with dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do much more on battery power. Multitask away, even when unplugged — turn on auto-framing, background blur, and low-light enhancement for your online meetings. Forget the usual constraints of running on battery and enjoy the extra push to power through anything that comes your way!
No Mouse Required
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop features a large TrackPad for easy navigation. Or, you can navigate with the TrackPoint — either way, when you’re on the go you can leave your mouse behind. What’s more, with a double tap of the little red nub, the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu opens to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription. You can even customize the settings!
Sight & Sound Sensation
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop is equipped with stunning display options, including a touchscreen and Eyesafe® certification for low blue light emissions. In addition, you’ll enjoy a sublime sound experience with the advanced Audio by Harman® and Dolby Atmos® whether you're listening to your favorite media or dialing into crystal-clear audio during conference calls. Keep your meetings in focus and your collaboration to a maximum.
ThinkPads: Tougher Than Your Monday Mornings
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for all of our ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Eco-Friendly Packaging & Recycled Components
Even with all its productivity and creativity-enhancing features, the ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop was designed with recycling front of mind. We used recycled post-consumer content (PCC) in various components, including an impressive 90% PCC recycled plastic used for the AC adaptor, 30% PCC for the speaker enclosure, and 25% PCC for the battery enclosure. Plus, the packaging is entirely devoid of plastic and is 100% recyclable — it’s even earned certification from the Forest Stewardship Council®, helping you make a responsible choice.
Security You Can Count On
Biometrics provides extra protection on the ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop — from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera to help you log in securely. Our robust suite of security solutions, ThinkShield, includes discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that encrypts vital data. Plus, AI-enabled Intel® Threat Detection Technology proactively guards against menaces such as ransomware and cryptojacking. With ThinkPad, rest assured, that your security and asset protection are our utmost priority

product_description:
The ThinkCentre neo 55s Gen 6 (13G1000EAC) packs professional performance into an 8.2L SFF chassis, ideal for workstations with limited space. This configuration prioritizes stability and manageability in corporate environments, with a 1-year Onsite warranty and an included upgrade to 3 years Onsite, ensuring continuous operation and extended support from day one.
Powered by an AMD Ryzen™ 5 220 (6C/12T, up to 4.9 GHz) with integrated Radeon™ 740M graphics, it delivers consistent responsiveness for office, web, and collaboration applications. It includes 8GB of DDR5-5600 RAM (2 SO-DIMM slots, up to 64GB dual-channel) and a 256GB M.2 2280 PCIe® 4.0x4 NVMe® Opal 2.0 SSD . For expanded storage capacity, it supports up to three drives: one 3.5" HDD (up to 2TB) and two M.2 SSDs (up to 1TB each). It also features a 200W power supply (90% efficiency).
Measuring 89 x 274.8 x 336 mm and weighing approximately 4.33 kg, the SFF form factor simplifies deployment and maintenance. It offers one PCIe® 4.0 x16 low-profile slot (length ≤ 155 mm, height ≤ 70 mm) for dedicated cards and three M.2 slots (one for WLAN and two for SSDs). It comes in Raven Black with a Calliope USB keyboard and mouse (ES-LA) included, ready for immediate integration into your workstation.
Connect via Wi-Fi® 6 (2x2) + Bluetooth® 5.3 and Gigabit Ethernet. Front: 1x USB-C® 5Gbps (15W charging), 2x USB-A 5Gbps, 3.5mm combo jack and 3.5mm microphone jack; rear: 2x USB-A 2.0, 2x USB-A 5Gbps (1 with Smart Power On), HDMI® 2.1 TMDS, DisplayPort™ 1.4, RJ-45 and line-out (3.5mm); optional serial port. For security, discrete TPM 2.0 (TCG/FIPS 140-2) and Kensington® Security Slot™.

Despite its tiny dimensions, the ThinkCentre neo 50q is surprisingly well equipped:

Always connected – even wirelessly

Housing and packaging with up to 90% recycled plastic
Use of ocean-bound plastic
EPEAT Gold , ENERGY STAR 9.0 and TCO 10.0 certified
TÜV Rheinland® Ultra Low Noise – for whisper-quiet operation in the office
Flexible mounting

Optionally available: Power adapter cage and vertical stand.
Redefining the size of small!

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (2023) NEW 13Gen Intel Core i7 vPro 14-Cores Powerful ISV-Certified Mobile Workstation w/ NVIDIA® RTX 2000 Ada 8GB DDR6 - Black
product_description:
Form meets function
The Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) is the perfect combination of form and function. Designed to be admired, its sleekness barely hints at what’s inside. A powerful system with the seamless performance of up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors and optional professional NVIDIA® discrete graphics.
Makes light work of heavy workloads
Certified by independent software vendors (ISVs), the Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) has been tested and proven to deliver efficient and seamless use of key applications. With this mobile workstation, you can rest easy knowing that it meet the demands of your business and your industry, wherever you need to work from.
See the complete list of ISV certifications
Visually captivating
With a large 16:10 aspect ratio screen, ideal for multitasking and larger workflows without sacrificing quality, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) gives you more bang for your buck. A content creator’s dream, this mobile workstation comes with a number of antiglare and TUV low-blue light display options, including an OLED touchscreen and factory color calibration for crisper, clearer images.
A webcam that’s got your front & back
The ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) boasts a hybrid FHD & infrared webcam as standard, so every videoconference is picture perfect. In addition, the webcam shutter and human presence detection helps to safeguard your privacy. You can also log in quickly and securely with just a smile via Windows Hello. And to further enhance your online meetings, there’s the option of a hybrid 5MP + infrared webcam.
The power to be free
For those who need to work from anywhere and need a workhorse that can plough through heavy computational workloads with ease, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) is ideal. As well as a myriad of ultra-fast memory and high performance storage, it boasts great WiFi connectivity and a large rapid-charging battery. The result? True on-the-go performance and power for anyone from designers to architects and VR/AR users to data scientists.
Productivity meets durability
The ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation is designed to meet your exacting needs. Its backlit, spill-resistant keyboard promotes faster, smoother typing. Its liquid metal design and vapor chamber offers advanced cooling to boost performance. It’s also MIL-SPEC certified and has passed more than 200 stringent Lenovo quality assessments, ensuring its reliability under pressure.
Security you can count on
The ThinkShield suite of hardware and software solutions is perfect for the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation, providing both device and key information security. Features include the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to encrypt your data and a biometric fingerprint reader for easy one-touch login. It also has the safety net of a self-healing BIOS to restore earlier system settings, if required.
Designed with the planet in mind
Engineered to reflect our commitment to the planet, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation includes recycled plastic, metal, and other materials. What's more, the packaging it comes in contains no plastic and 90% of it is sustainably made, including biobased and sustainably forested content.

Sustainability
Our goal is to provide smarter technology that builds a brighter, more sustainable future for our customers, communities, and the planet. product_name: Lenovo NEW ThinkCentre NEO 50t Gen 5 (2024) Tower Desktop14GEN Intel Core i5 10-Cores w/ Wireless & Bluetooth - Black
product_description:
Powerful Desktop for Every Business
To meet the needs of modern workspaces, the ThinkCentre neo 50t Gen 5 Tower is a powerful 13.6L desktop with a professional design. It is ideal for manufacturing, product design, and other business sectors — driven by enterprise-grade performance, boasting industry-leading connectivity and collaboration options to keep your productivity at peak.
Intelligent Cooling Engine
Experience adaptive cooling with Intelligent Cooling Engine (ICE) 7.0 to extend the lifecycle of the PC. Keep the system cooler, boost performance, and switch seamlessly between modes.
Mindful About Tomorrow
The chassis uses 85% post-consumer content recycled acrylonitrile butadiene styrene plastics. The packaging cushion has 90% post-industry content recycled expanded polyethylene and 30% ocean-bound plastic in the bag with a Forest Stewardship Council® (FSC) certified carton. Plus, ENERGY STAR® 8.0 and TCO 9.0 ratings minimise energy costs.
Cross-Device Interaction for Multitasking
Take device collaboration to the next level with the Smart Connect app — sync presentations effortlessly across PCs, mobile phones, and tablets during meetings. Link your desktop to multiple peripherals via different ports, optional Smart Cable, and expansion slots like a 3-in-1 card reader, serial, parallel, PS2, etc. for enhanced operations.
Tap Into Limitless Potential
Boost your business performance with up to 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processor — driving productivity and innovation beyond expectations. Plus, the ThinkCentre neo 50t Gen 5 Tower powers through complex analyses and creative projects with vast memory, and multiple storage options.
Secured with ThinkShield & More
ThinkShield security delivers hardware and software solutions, including discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 to safeguard data, and BIOS-based Smart USB protection to prevent unauthorised access via peripherals. Keep physical theft at bay with Kensington Security Slot™, padlock loop, optional cable lock, or an intrusion switch cable.

product_description:
Business power with an earth-friendly spin
Go high and low with the ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower. For high performance, choose up to a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ CPU—with more processing cores than earlier versions. For low impact on the planet, rest easy knowing the sleek black chassis includes post-consumer plastic resins, packaging is 90% easy-to-recycle expanded polyethylene (EPE), and the system is certified to meet multiple important environmental standards.
Cool, quiet productivity
You’ll hear and feel the difference. Equipped with the Intelligent Cooling Engine (ICE) 6.0, power consumption is optimised to keep the system cool—even when you’re working hard. Multiple operating modes are suited to different business settings. Fan sounds and ambient noise are minimised, too.
New ways to share & collaborate
Collaboration is fast and easy on the ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower. Wired and wireless connectivity—up to WiFi 6—makes sharing project ideas a breeze. Remote meetings are a snap thanks to Windows 11 Pro and Microsoft Teams integration. And attaching an optional Smart Cable opens a world of possibilities, including connecting to another PC to leverage its storage and other components.
Device & data security
The ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower is protected by our ThinkShield security solutions—a suite of hardware and software that work together to safeguard both your device and your data. From discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that encrypts your passwords, to physical security options, to a self-healing BIOS with BIOS Guard and Boot Guard, to smart USB protection — we’ve got you covered.

product_name: Lenovo NEW ThinkPad Edge E14 Gen 7 (2025) Intel® Ultra 7 Gen II 255H HIGH Performance 16-Core Intel® AI Boost w/ DDR5 Memory & Backlit keyboard
product_description:
The Unplugged Multitasker
With Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop brings AI-assisted productivity to the forefront. Enjoy optimized performance with dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do much more on battery power. Multitask away, even when unplugged — turn on auto-framing, background blur, and low-light enhancement for your online meetings. Forget the usual constraints of running on battery and enjoy the extra push to power through anything that comes your way!
No Mouse Required
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop features a large TrackPad for easy navigation. Or, you can navigate with the TrackPoint — either way, when you’re on the go you can leave your mouse behind. What’s more, with a double tap of the little red nub, the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu opens to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription. You can even customize the settings!
Sight & Sound Sensation
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop is equipped with stunning display options, including a touchscreen and Eyesafe® certification for low blue light emissions. In addition, you’ll enjoy a sublime sound experience with the advanced Audio by Harman® and Dolby Atmos® whether you're listening to your favorite media or dialing into crystal-clear audio during conference calls. Keep your meetings in focus and your collaboration to a maximum.
ThinkPads: Tougher Than Your Monday Mornings
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for all of our ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Eco-Friendly Packaging & Recycled Components
Even with all its productivity and creativity-enhancing features, the ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop was designed with recycling front of mind. We used recycled post-consumer content (PCC) in various components, including an impressive 90% PCC recycled plastic used for the AC adaptor, 30% PCC for the speaker enclosure, and 25% PCC for the battery enclosure. Plus, the packaging is entirely devoid of plastic and is 100% recyclable — it’s even earned certification from the Forest Stewardship Council®, helping you make a responsible choice.
Security You Can Count On
Biometrics provides extra protection on the ThinkPad E14 Gen 6 laptop — from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera to help you log in securely. Our robust suite of security solutions, ThinkShield, includes discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that encrypts vital data. Plus, AI-enabled Intel® Threat Detection Technology proactively guards against menaces such as ransomware and cryptojacking. With ThinkPad, rest assured, that your security and asset protection are our utmost priority

AI-Driven Productivity — On the Go
Powered by Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the 14ʺ Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 laptop taps into AI-assisted productivity like never before. Enjoy optimized performance with workloads pushed to dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do more, unplugged. Choose Intel vPro®, for multilayer security, professional-grade performance, reliable stability, and complete management for IT. And, fuel your efficiency with Windows Copilot, launched with a single keystroke, to adjust PC settings or switch between projects.
Next-Level Viewing — Bold & Bright
Whether — watching or creating, experience superb content quality on the 14” ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 laptop. Its 3M optical solutions boost display efficiency, maximizing the brightness levels while reducing power usage. Plus narrow bezels along with Dolby Vision® ensure you’ll enjoy rich, vibrant visuals. Certified for Eyesafe® and TÜV Low Blue Light protection, it prevents eye fatigue during long work hours. Moreover, it’s slim, lightweight, and comes in two elegant colors Eclipse Black and Luna Grey to match your personal style.
Inclusive Design for Easy Access
Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard now includes tactile markings to help visually impaired folks easily find the correct keys. Our TrackPad is even bigger now, at 120mm / 4.72ʺ. And our beloved red TrackPoint still lets you navigate — but with a double tap, it opens the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
Go Calm, Cool, & Secure
Level up your efficiency with advanced thermal management and adaptive battery enhancement tailored to your workflow. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 laptop comes equipped with strategically placed rear air vents to ensure optimal cooling efficiency while you crunch your computing tasks. And, adapting to your workload, it extends battery life when you need it the most. Plus, it includes ThinkShield security for comprehensive data protection and comes with an optional match-on-chip fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to enable secure device access.
Simplified Swaps & Repairs
Engineered to endure, the ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 laptop is designed for easy upgrades with swappable components. You can easily replace or repair your system memory, SSD, battery, keyboard, and WWAN with convenient customer replaceable units (CRUs) even without tech expertise. In fact, for its ease of maintenance and remarkable do-it-yourself serviceability, this laptop boasts an industry-leading 9.3/10 on the iFixit Repairability Score. So, whether you wish to upgrade components or extend your device’s lifespan, you can trust our support services to keep your system and your business — up and running.
Built Strong, Stays Strong
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD-810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more. What’s more, while the ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 is built for durability, it’s also engineered to be power efficient with an ENERGY STAR® 8.0 certification.

Get set for victory, because the Legion TrueStrike keyboard isn't just a tool, it's your ultimate gaming and coding ally.
Style from the arena to the lab

Capture every moment in crystal clear 1080p with the integrated camera, and stay in control with the e-privacy shutter. The Legion 5i Gen 9 16" isn’t just powerful, it’s your reliable wingman in the pursuit of victory and innovation.
Charge in a flash, game to the max

With Super Rapid Charge you can avoid the dorm and get swift recharging, reaching up to 30% of battery life in just 10 minutes, and a substantial 70% in 30 minutes. Perfect for students and gamers on the move. Whether you’re diving into gaming, powering through school projects, or binge-watching your favourite shows, the Legion 5i Gen 9 16" has the power to keep up with you.
Speed & space unleashed
With memory up to a whopping 32GB and two SO-DIMM slots for future expansion, you can experience unparallelled multitasking and swift performance. Whether you’re gaming, streaming, or tackling tasks, the Legion 5i Gen 9 16" is here for you. There’s plenty of storage to save your projects, and with high-speed DDR5 memory, your favourite apps will launch in a breeze. This future-proof laptop with room for upgrades is built to last.
Gear up, game on
Legion gives you the freedom to choose your gear, ensuring you’re always ready to elevate your game. Build your ultimate setup with accessories like the Legion Y27h-30 monitor, Legion M300 RGB Gaming Mouse, Legion H200 Gaming Headset, Legion K300 RGB Gaming Keyboard, and the Legion Gaming Mouse Pad. Stay connected, stay in control, and stay ahead with Legion accessories.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic® by SteelSeries on the Legion 5i Gen 9 16". Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game journey. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality, or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic® doesn’t just enhance your gaming, it immerses you in it.
Embrace the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage allows you to optimise settings elevating your gaming experience. You can adjust, customise, and maximise your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls, and Custom Mode with fan control, nothing stands in the way of your success.
Legion Arena, the ultimate gaming hub
Your games all in one place. Legion Arena’s centralised gaming hub easily syncs with popular stores and gaming platforms to give you complete control over how you play, browse, and manage your game library. You can access all your games in one place, no more switching between apps to find your favourite games.

product_description:
For Faster Processing & Performance
Optimised for a higher performance, the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop boasts exceptional AI capabilities. It is equipped with robust Intel® Core™ Ultra processors and combines the power of neural processing to expedite AI tasks. Whether writing code or making presentations — you can take full advantage of accelerated AI to improve your productivity. Plus, enjoy multitasking with superior battery performance that keeps you on the go all day and rapid charging when you need some juice. Get ready to enjoy the best AI PC experience.
Comfortable, Convenient & Always at Hand
Enjoy the versatility of a convertible laptop with the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4, which boasts the addition of the Lenovo Slim Pen. Magnetically attach it to the side of the keyboard and keep it conveniently within reach at your fingertips. Whether using it as a laptop or a tablet, get easy control for tasks like sketching, note-taking, navigation, or even signing a document with a bigger and more comfortable stylus.
See & Feel the Extraordinary
The hidden hinge design of the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop offers an immersive audio-visual experience. With ultra-narrow bezels and enlarged screen real estate, this convertible laptop shows its charm, and is ideal for work, school, and media. This multiuse laptop boasts several intelligent meeting features like auto-framing, noise cancellation, blur background, and more. Plus, it offers smart network connectivity, consistent audio supported by Dolby Atmos®, and exudes a classy appearance in Luna Grey.
Keystrokes — More Enjoyable & Convenient
The ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop boasts a revamped keyboard design with keys more comfortable to the touch. A spacious key layout ensures faster and more accurate typing, while also being highly resilient against dirt and spills. We’ve also added LED indicators on the microphone and speaker keys so it’s easy to see when they’re in use. But the best part? We’ve used 50% recycled post-consumer content (PCC) plastics in the keycaps and 50% recycled metal on the bottom cover — so you can feel good on multiple levels.
Become Flexibly Secure
Alongside security, the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop offers login flexibility to safeguard data with your fingerprint. The power button embeds an match-on-chip fingerprint reader that stores immutable credentials on a chip, while letting you safely log in and boot up in mere seconds. ThinkShield, our integrated suite of security offerings, encrypts data with discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM). Plus, with Windows facial recognition and the optional infrared (IR) camera, the system will instantly resume from hibernate or standby mode.
Designed to be Future-Proof
The ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 convertible laptop is an ideal choice for small-to-mid-sized businesses handling enterprise-level tasks. It offers ample responsive memory for multitasking and tackles demanding workloads with heavy data records. With its dual memory and storage slots, this versatile 2-in-1 laptop is engineered to adapt to changing future demands — you can easily upgrade your specs as your business grows, even without tech expertise. Simply remove the bottom cover for easy access to the upgradeable slots.

It also has option dual expansion ports that can be configured to meet your exact needs. Ideal for the modern professional, whether you're in healthcare, retail, or the front or back office.
Security inside & out
Every ThinkCentre lets you innovate fearlessly with the reinforced security of ThinkShield, our comprehensive end-to-end security solution. Combining industry-leading hardware, software, and services, it's designed to safeguard your data, ideas, and business. This Tiny desktop includes a self-healing BIOS, a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) to encrypt your data, and a Kensington Security Slot™ to physically secure your PC. And when you choose the Intel vPro® platform, you have additional multilayer, hardware-based protection.
Designed for today & tomorrow
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny (Intel) desktop is easy to deploy, upgrade, and manage. With toolless access to the solid state drive and memory module, it’s also a breeze to expand and maintain. What's more, this PC can connect with legacy computing peripherals and is designed to grow with your business.
As versatile as it is powerful
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny (Intel) is designed with people — and shrinking workspaces — in mind. Its sleek, modern design and compact 1L form allow this Tiny PC to fit seamlessly anywhere. It can sit on a desk, be mounted on a wall or out of the way, or slid snugly into the back of a ThinkCentre Tiny-in-One (TIO) monitor. It can also support up to four displays and its ports offer fast charging and quick data sharing.
It won’t let you down
Our dedication to constantly improving product quality means rigorous testing for durability and reliability. In addition to our extensive in-house testing for real-world challenges, the ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny desktop is tested against the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards. These tests cover harsh variables like the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms. It also meets stringent tests for temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Less impactful on the planet & users
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny PC also meets various global standards for energy-efficiency and health & safety, including ENERGY STAR® 8.0 and EPEAT® Gold. Additionally, it’s been low-noise certified by TÜV Rheinland. It also comes with the option of ThinkCentre Tiny Dust Shield, which is easy to remove, wash, and replace, and helps to prolong the life of your PC.

Ready for Anything & Everything
The 16” Lenovo ThinkPad E16 Gen 3 ensures elevated productivity with Intel® Core™ Ultra processors. Empowering Your Work, Your Connection, Your Vision
Built Tough, Designed Smart
Engineered to endure, this notebook combines military-grade durability in a sleek, compact build for seamless mobility and uncompromised performance. Plus, its thoughtfully crafted, using recycled materials to reduce environmental impact.
Stay Unplugged, Stay Productive
Stay powered up and productive with prolonged battery life, designed to keep pace with your busiest days. Whether you're in back-to-back meetings, traveling places, or working remotely, this laptop delivers extended use without frequent recharging.
Superior Audiovisual Experience
The 16″ display on the ThinkPad E16 Gen 3 laptop makes every frame pop — perfect for bright environments or detailed content work. Where Comfort & Efficiency Click
Experience ultimate typing comfort with our improved keyboard with tactile markings and backlit option for ease of use. Its ergonomic layout includes a numeric keypad to boost productivity, while the TrackPoint Quick Menu helps streamline workflows.
UNCOMPROMISING SECURITY
Advanced Protection for Peace of Mind
Enjoy top-tier security with the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) which provides robust data encryption. Plus, the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button and an optional FHD hybrid infrared (IR) camera provide secure logins, while the webcam privacy shutter adds an extra layer of control.
YOUR BRIDGE TO BETTER BUSINESS
Empower Your Workflows with Speed & Versatility
The ThinkPad E16 Gen 3 redefines connectivity with speedy WiFi and a wide array of versatile ports, including USB-A, USB-C®, Thunderbolt 4, and HDMI®. Tailored for SMBs and enterprises, it ensures seamless device integration, rapid data transfers, and smooth collaboration, making daily operations more efficient and productivity effortless.
CREDIBILITY & COLLABORATION
Sustainability
Our goal is to provide smarter technology that builds a brighter, more sustainable future for our customers, communities, and the planet. That's why we pursue industry leading labels and certifications that demonstrate our commitment to sustainability in product design. Together, we can build a smarter future for all.

The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 boasts the world’s first laptop powered by Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, making it ideal for creating and on-the-go productivity. Enjoy optimized performance with workloads pushed to dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) for sustained tasks and resilient battery life. Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard now includes tactile markings to help people with visual impairments more easily find the correct keys. We’ve moved the fingerprint reader to the keyboard, resulting in a larger sensor for a better experience. Plus, our TrackPad is even larger now, at 120mm / 4.72ʺ. Our beloved red TrackPoint still lets you navigate —  but with a double tap, it opens the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.

Lenovo View is an AI-based camera app that enhances video quality and provides intelligent collaboration, privacy, and digital wellness features. Lenovo Vantage centralizes settings to safeguard data, automate updates, and improve performance — or Lenovo Commercial Vantage for IT manageability. We make it easier and safer to do your job well.
Stand Tough With Battle-Tested ThinkPad
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Your Face. Your Fingerprint. Your Fortress.
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop, from the fingerprint reader to facial recognition software. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, boasts discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to safeguard critical data with encryption. Plus, AI-powered Intel® Threat Detection Technology helps prevent ransomware, cryptojacking, and more. When it comes to security and protecting your assets, we’ve got you covered

For ease of maintenance and do-it-yourself serviceability, this laptop boasts an industry-leading 9/10 on the iFixit Repairability Score. The T16 Gen 3 is more accessible to the visually impaired not only due to tactile keyboard markers – it also features an LED Braille indicator for easy location of the power port. We’ve also redesigned the ThinkPad T16 laptop’s thermals. Its fan directs the airflow to the rear of the laptop rather than the side, keeping your mouse hand—and the laptop—cooler. This also allows an increase in thermal design power, for better performance.
Keeping Your Data Locked Down Tight
Biometrics protect the ThinkPad T16 Gen 3 laptop, from the optional fingerprint reader to facial recognition software with the optional IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, boasts discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to safeguard critical data with encryption. Plus, AI-based Intel® Hardware Shield helps prevent and defend against attacks.
Commitment to Sustainability
We’re committed to making a positive impact on our environment. This laptop uses post-consumer content (PCC) recycled plastic in various components, including 90% in the AC adapter, battery enclosure, and speaker enclosure. Plus it’s certified ENERGY STAR 8.0 & TCO 9, and packaging is 100% plastic-free, certified by the FSC

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 (2023) 13Gen Intel Core i7 10-Cores MIL-STD 810H Standards w/ Carbon Fiber & Aluminium Material
product_description:
Takes productivity to the next level
Co-engineered with Intel®, the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 meets Intel® Evo™ laptop design requirements, hardware specifications, and key user experience targets for consistent responsiveness, instant wake, all-day battery life, fast charging, and intelligent video conferencing. This Evo-certified device also includes Intel® Unison™ for seamless connectivity with your Android or iOS smart phone for calling, messaging, and file and photo sharing—all done from your laptop.
Collaborating remotely never looked or sounded so good
The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop includes a highly functional and stylish Communications Bar, which houses an FHD camera or a hybrid FHD and infrared (IR) camera. Or go big with the FHD / IR mobile industry processor interface (MIPI) webcam with Computer Vision’s added security. And, of course, all cameras include the webcam privacy shutter. What’s more, 4 x 360-degree mics with integrated AI-based noise cancellation and Dolby Voice® deliver superb audio. With the quality of video calls this amazing, you may never want to commute to an office again.
Effortless connection with your phone
With Intel® Unison™, you can put your laptop at the center of all that you do. Wirelessly connect your phone—either Android or iOS—to your ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop. Transfer files quickly and easily, even edit your photos and videos seamlessly on the big screen. Make and answer calls directly from your PC, with full access to your phone’s contact list. You can even receive notifications on your laptop, as well as messaging. No need to switch devices when you can do it all in one place.
Bumps up the coolness factor
The legendary ThinkPad keyboard is designed for ergonomics and comfort—and part of that comfort means improved airflow. The underside of the keys facilitates air intake when in use. Combined with the dual fan and rear venting, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 notebook delivers improved thermals. So whether you’re powering through your day, or your night, or both, the ThinkPad X1 will stay as cool as you are.
Vibrant visuals that suit your needs
No matter how you look at it, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop features stunning displays that meet your workday needs. Whether you require richly detailed graphics with super-high screen resolution, or extra security to combat prying eyes, we’ve got options for you. Ranging from a widescreen ultra extended graphics array (WUXGA) touchscreen to a 2.8K OLED display, to a WUXGA with ePrivacy, all of the 14ʺ panels feature a 16:10 aspect ratio with maximum screen real estate. What’s more, almost all selections include Eyesafe® certification to reduce eye fatigue.
Security that works 24/7
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 system—from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to all our business laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) safeguard your critical data with encryption. Presence detection automatically locks your device when you move away, while the optional PrivacyGuard display prevents wandering eyes from seeing what’s on your screen.
Trusted ThinkPad quality
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Feel good about the planet
At Lenovo, we take sustainability seriously. We’ve committed to net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, making us the world’s first PC and smartphone maker and one of only 139 companies with a net-zero target validated by Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). For the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11, that means low-temp soldering and 90% recycled magnesium on the C cover. We use 98% post-consumer content (PCC) recycled plastic in the speaker enclosure, 25-30% PCC recycled plastic in the battery enclosure, and 90% PCC recycled plastic in the power adapter. Packaging is entirely plastic-free.
Zoom certification
Being Zoom certified means exceptional experiences under all the Zoom offerings. From meeting spaces and webinars to events and team chats. From booking conference rooms to sending email. From virtual customer service agents to driving loyalty and retention. From leveraging AI to mine customer conversations to delivering a platform for developers. The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 raises the bar for interactions with Zoom One, Zoom Spaces, Zoom Contact Center, Zoom IQ for Sales, and Zoom Developers.

The ThinkStation P2 Tower workstation brings high-end workstation performance within reach of everyone — from engineers to designers to data analysts and students. This entry-level workstation is a perfect ally for professionals working with loads of data. Equipped with the power of Intel® Core™ processing, the ThinkStation P2 Tower can execute huge, complex datasets — at a lightning fast speed, seamlessly. Your Fortress in Every Sense of the World
Enjoy fortified protection inside and out with the ThinkStation P2 tower. It comes with ThinkShield, our hardware and software suite of security solutions, to help safeguard your workstation and your data comprehensively. In addition, a Kensington Security Slot™ provides physical security and get timely firmware update support from Windows to strengthen your defence mechanisms.
A Smart Choice Respecting the Planet

It includes 95% post-consumer content recycled plastic in front bezel. Plus, its carton packaging is 90% recycled and certified by Forest Stewardship Coincil (FSC) while its cushion packaging uses 90% recycled expanded polyethylene (EPE). So, whether you’re an entry-level engineer, product designer, teacher or student, you’ve got a reliable choice for the performance you need to streamline your workflows.

product_name: Lenovo NEW ThinkPad Z16 Gen 2 (2024) Elevated Experience & Exceptional Power AMD Ryzen 9 Pro 7Gen 8-Core AMD Ryzen™ AI w/ Plastic-Free Material & 4K OLED Touch Display - Black/Grey
product_description:
Redefines the term ‘powerhouse’
With AMD Ryzen™ PRO 7040 H Series mobile processors, the Lenovo ThinkPad Z16 laptop delivers some serious power. Plus, with the choice of higher-end integrated or discrete graphics, there’s not much this machine can’t do. Enjoy our best videoconferencing, AI-powered audio enhancements, and epic battery life. Combined with the ultraresponsive Windows 11 Pro option, this powerhouse blazes through tasks lightning-fast.
Security as unique as you
All ThinkPad laptops include ThinkShield, a suite of security solutions engineered to safeguard your business. Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad Z16 Gen 2 laptop — from the fingerprint reader to the facial recognition software that works with the infrared (IR) camera to log in with your smile. AMD Memory Guard helps secure your entire system memory. Plus, to further assure your privacy, an electronic shutter controlled by the F9 key keeps the camera off when you want it to be.
Look good — feel even better
A laptop that feels as good as it looks, the eco-focused ThinkPad Z16 Gen 2 reflects your commitment to the planet. On the outside, it boasts a sleek Arctic Grey recycled-aluminum chassis and glass haptic trackpad. Inside, there are components made from post-consumer recycled plastics, while the manufacturing process uses low-temp soldering to reduce emissions and leave a smaller carbon footprint. Packaging is entirely plastic-free, made from a bamboo-sugarcane fiber that’s 100% rapid-renewable and compostable. And of course it’s ENERGY STAR® certified, too.
Makes online meetings a dream
Front and center on the ThinkPad Z16 Gen 2 laptop is a Communications Bar. It houses a great camera with FHD resolution and infrared technology, plus AI-based noise-cancelling mics with Dolby Voice® and adjustable settings. Enjoy the user-facing Dolby Atmos™ speakers, for high fidelity sound. There’s even an e-shutter key to turn off the camera, instantly. Optimized audio-video makes this device a true collaboration tool.  One that, should working from anywhere prevent you from being in the same room as your team, delivers the next best thing — or maybe even the best thing.
Think reliability
We use the US Department of Defense’s MIL-STD 810H standards to strike a perfect balance of value and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 military-grade standards, 26 procedures, and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. From the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms, these tests cover harsh environmental variables, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration testing, and more.
Experience the Wow! factor
Renowned for its comfort and typing experience, the ThinkPad keyboard on the Z16 Gen 2 laptop truly excels. It has a glass haptic trackpad, which feels sleek to the touch and provides effortless navigation. Even better is the dual-function TrackPoint — our beloved red dot — use it like a mouse or to launch the TrackPoint Quick Menu settings. Simply double-tap for quick access to camera and mic optimization. There’s even a Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription — how’s that for taking notes?!
No matter how you look at it
With all the thought we’ve put into the ThinkPad Z16 Gen 2 laptop, it’s no wonder the choice of displays includes a premium WQUXGA OLED panel. You’ll enjoy rich details and vibrant colors on a 16″ touchscreen with Dolby Vision® and 100% color gamut — especially useful for work where every pixel counts. Or for a more efficient, low-power display, go with the WUXGA, which includes a choice of touchscreen, and looks impressive in its own right. Beyond Fast
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built for the era of AI, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the Max-Q suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
Enjoy 3 Months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on Lenovo LOQ
Play Forza Horizon 5, Battlefield V, and hundreds of other PC games on the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 with 3 months of Game Pass, including EA Play. Enjoy iconic franchises like Halo, and many more. Plus, you get free perks, including in-game content, consumables, and more, as well as member discounts of up to 20% off select games in the Game Pass library, and up to 10% off related game add-ons. Gaming at Your Coolest
Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9's revolutionary hyper chamber thermal design is a game-changer. The hyper chamber was purposefully designed for gaming, employing dual fans that spin outward to efficiently expel heat from the back of the device. No more hot air blowing on your hand during a game. The sealed chamber also grants an extra 10W of power (maximum 160W thermal design power), reduces skin temperature by 2°C, and decreases noise by 2dB. Whether in an epic gaming session or a library's quiet zone, enjoy your laptop in cool silence.
Gaming in Vivid Detail
Immerse yourself in rich visuals on the 15.6″ 16:9 display, coupled with 3-side narrow bezels. Stunning   resolution, fast refresh rates, and high brightness ensure a vivid picture. Complete sRGB coverage enhances colors, while NVIDIA® G-SYNC® eliminates screen tearing and stuttering. Advanced Optimus switches between integrated and dedicated graphics to optimize performance, reduce latency, and extend battery life for an unparalleled gaming experience.
Your Key to Winning
With 1.5mm key travel, the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 laptop’s keyboard offers precision and comfort — perfect for gaming and extended typing sessions. Enjoy 100% anti-ghosting for accuracy during intense gameplay. Choose between calming white backlighting or vibrant 4-zone RGB lighting, and personalize it further with swappable keycaps.
Immersive 3D Audio
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries on the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 laptop. Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game experience. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic doesn't just enhance your gaming — it immerses you in it.

And if the mood to read strikes after lights out, Kindle Paperwhite Kids has an adjustable warm light to shift the shade of the screen from white light to a warm amber. You can also set a Bedtime for each child profile on the Parent Dashboard, to help avoid bedtime disagreements.

Parent Dashboard allows parents to get the most out of Kindle Paperwhite Kids. You can adjust age filters, add books to your child's library, view your child's reading progress, and more.

Amazon Kids+ includes the complete Harry Potter series, and the first book from other popular series such as Artemis Fowl. Amazon Kids+ provides access to books over a range of reading levels, and automatically filters out what your child sees based on their age. To see a wider selection of titles, go to Parent Dashboard to adjust the age filter in your child's profile setting. product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad Edge E16 Gen 2 (2024) Intel® Ultra 7 155H HIGH Performance 16-Core Intel® AI Boost w/ DDR5 Memory & Backlit keyboard
product_description:
Enhanced Performance
With Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop brings AI-assisted productivity to the forefront. Enjoy optimized performance with dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do much more on battery power. Multitask away, even when unplugged — turn on auto-framing, background blur, and low-light enhancement for your online meetings.
Accurate & Ergonomic Keyboard
The ThinkPad E16 G2 (16″ Intel) laptop features a full-sized keyboard that includes a numeric pad — perfect for financial services, data analysis, or any detailed tasks involving number crunching. Navigate with the TrackPad or the TrackPoint and leave your mouse behind. Plus, with a double tap of the little red nub, the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu opens to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
Sound Collaborator
The laptop boasts an impressive display, offering an exceptional visual experience. With a range of sharp and focused resolutions available, images are rendered with stunning detail and vibrancy. Keep your meetings in focus and collaboration to a maximum. This ThinkPad is ideal for anyone on the go or working from home. In addition, this laptop boasts Audio by Harman® and Dolby Atmos® that’ll help you rock out to your favorite media and sound crystal-clear during conference calls.
Ready to Work, Anywhere
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for all of our ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Recycled Components & Eco-conscious Packaging
Even with all its productivity and collaboration-enhancing features, this ThinkPad was designed with recycling in mind. We used recycled post-consumer content (PCC) in various components. The battery pack is made of 25% PCC recycled plastic, which is a big step towards sustainability. The speaker enclosure is 30% PCC recycled plastic, while the AC Adaptor rocks a cool 90% PCC recycled plastic composition. Plus, the packaging is completely plastic-free and 100% recyclable – and is Forest Stewardship Council® certified, so you can feel good about choosing this laptop.
Safe & Secure Computing
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop — from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. Our robust suite of security solutions, ThinkShield, includes discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that ensures the encryption of vital data. Moreover, it uses AI-enabled Intel® Threat Detection Technology to proactively guard against threats such as ransomware and cryptojacking. With ThinkPad, rest assured, that your security and asset protection are our utmost priority.

360 degrees of adaptability
Create, play and work on a device that adapts to whatever you're doing with 360 degrees of freedom on the convertible Lenovo Flex 7i. Rotate the hinge into tent or stand modes to watch your shows or switch to tablet mode to browse through as you hold the ultrathin-and-light Stone Blue chassis that slims down to 17.4mm and weighs just 1.5kg. Rugged and ergonomic, the drop-down hinge has been durability tested 25,000 times, gently lifting the keyboard to cover the display's bottom bezel and afford users a more comfortable typing angle and larger screen ratio.
Soak in the photorealistic color
Experience stunning realistic color, sharp contrast and vivid detail with an up-to-2.2K 14" display that features 100% sRGB color gamut for enhanced photorealism and 300 nits brightness for easier outdoors viewing. Cut down on eye strain with TUV certification and elevate your visual field with a taller 16:10 display sporting narrow bezels on all sides and a drop-down hinge for a greater-than-90% screen-to-body ratio.
Break new performance barriers
Break your creativity, gaming, streaming and productivity barriers with the Intel® Evo™-certified Lenovo Flex 7i, featuring 12th Generation Intel Core™ processors for real-world multitasking and performance that scales up as your workload intensifies. Video chat, game or edit 3D videos--your system keeps cool and quiet under heavy loads thanks to its Intelligent Cooling fan system, which optimizes for Quiet, Balance and Performance--depending on your needs. And up to 1TB PCIe SSD offers near-limitless storage at blazing speeds.
Start, charge and connect faster
Do things faster, better and at a lower latency with two hours of battery life on a 15-minute charge via rapid-charge boost, secure and effortless log-in with a fingerprint sensor and Wi-Fi 6E, offering dedicated high-speed channels and no legacy Wi-Fi interference for seamless videoconferencing, cloud gaming and other real-time applications. Access universal cable connectivity from Type-C port charging and Thunderbolt 4.0, which can connect multiple devices such as two 4K monitors while delivering 40Gbps bi-directional bandwidth. product_description:
Enhanced Performance
With Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop brings AI-assisted productivity to the forefront. Enjoy optimized performance with dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do much more on battery power. Multitask away, even when unplugged — turn on auto-framing, background blur, and low-light enhancement for your online meetings.
Accurate & Ergonomic Keyboard
The ThinkPad E16 G2 (16″ Intel) laptop features a full-sized keyboard that includes a numeric pad — perfect for financial services, data analysis, or any detailed tasks involving number crunching. Navigate with the TrackPad or the TrackPoint and leave your mouse behind. Plus, with a double tap of the little red nub, the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu opens to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
Sound Collaborator
The laptop boasts an impressive display, offering an exceptional visual experience. With a range of sharp and focused resolutions available, images are rendered with stunning detail and vibrancy. Keep your meetings in focus and collaboration to a maximum. This ThinkPad is ideal for anyone on the go or working from home. In addition, this laptop boasts Audio by Harman® and Dolby Atmos® that’ll help you rock out to your favorite media and sound crystal-clear during conference calls.
Ready to Work, Anywhere
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for all of our ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Recycled Components & Eco-conscious Packaging
Even with all its productivity and collaboration-enhancing features, this ThinkPad was designed with recycling in mind. We used recycled post-consumer content (PCC) in various components. The battery pack is made of 25% PCC recycled plastic, which is a big step towards sustainability. The speaker enclosure is 30% PCC recycled plastic, while the AC Adaptor rocks a cool 90% PCC recycled plastic composition. Plus, the packaging is completely plastic-free and 100% recyclable – and is Forest Stewardship Council® certified, so you can feel good about choosing this laptop.
Safe & Secure Computing
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop — from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. Our robust suite of security solutions, ThinkShield, includes discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that ensures the encryption of vital data. Moreover, it uses AI-enabled Intel® Threat Detection Technology to proactively guard against threats such as ransomware and cryptojacking. With ThinkPad, rest assured, that your security and asset protection are our utmost priority.

product_name: Lenovo ThinkStation P3 Tiny Workstation (2023) 13Gen Intel Core i7 vPro 16-Cores Superior Performance w/ NVIDIA® T400 4GB GDDR6 - Black
product_description:
Tiny yet powerful
Engineered to go where other PCs can’t, the Lenovo ThinkStation P3 Tiny combines simple and efficient design with professional-level power. With a total volume of just 1L, it’s the world's smallest workstation and some 96% smaller than a traditional desktop. What it lacks in size, however, it more than makes up in uncompromising performance, powered by Intel Core™ processors with Intel vPro® and optional NVIDIA® professional discrete graphics. It can also support up to six independent displays.
Built for the modern world
Incredibly reliable and easy to deploy, the ThinkStation P3 Tiny offers great versatility. As well as an array of mounting options, you can put it on a bookshelf or desk, tuck it away behind a monitor, or use it as a powerful on-the-go desktop between work and home. A proven industry workhorse in a conveniently pint-sized package, it’s ideal for professionals working across architecture, engineering, finance, healthcare, and STEM education.
Configure it your way
With a choice of operating systems, including Windows 11 Pro and Linux®*, the ThinkStation P3 Tiny can be configured to meet your most exacting needs. As well as NVIDIA® discrete graphics, it can host a vast amount of speedy DDR5 memory and SSD storage, and the option of a dust filter to help extend the life of your ThinkStation.
*Available summer 2023
Proven to handle almost anything
One of the cornerstones of the ThinkStation P3 Tiny workstation is reliability. MIL-SPEC-certified, it's been proven to meet military-grade standards and quality checks to ensure it will run in extreme conditions, from the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms. It also comes with an array of independent software vendor (ISV) certifications, so you can power through heavy workloads in applications like AutoCAD®, Revit®, and SOLIDWORKS© without missing a beat.
See the complete list of ISV certifications
No compromise security
The ThinkStation P3 Tiny workstation comes with ThinkShield, a combination of hardware and software that work together to safeguard both your device and your data. This includes essential security features like Trusted Platform Module (TPM) that encrypts your data and programs to prevent unauthorized system access. It even has a self-healing BIOS that's programmed to restore your machine to its previous state if the BIOS becomes corrupt or is maliciously attacked
