product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (2024) Intel Core Ultra 7 165U vPro 12-Cores w/ Intel® AI Boost NPU & Carbon Fiber Magnesium Chassis & Touch Screen - Black
product_description:
How Do You Show Respect for the Planet?
The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (14ʺ Intel) laptop still uses carbon fiber for the chassis — but better yet some of that carbon fiber is recycled from post-industrial remnants and is used along with 90% recycled magnesium. Plus, the chassis, the battery pack, the speaker enclosure, and the power adapter all include recycled post-consumer content. And we don’t stop there. The packaging is 100% plastic-free and comprised in part with rapid-renewable materials made from bamboo-sugar-cane fiber.
Elevated Performance & Lasting Battery
The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 boasts the world’s first laptop powered by Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, making it ideal for creating and on-the-go productivity. Enjoy optimized performance with workloads pushed to dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) for sustained tasks and resilient battery life. Go ahead, turn on auto-framing or low-light enhancement for your online meetings, even when unplugged! Choose the Intel vPro® Evo™ Edition, for multilayer security, professional-grade performance, reliable stability, and complete management for IT.
Raise the Bar on Collaboration
A Communications Bar, positioned at the top of the display for easy laptop opening, houses two cameras (FHD / infrared (IR)) — or upgrade to the premium 8MP & IR Mobile Industry Processor Interface (MIPI) with Computer Vision — both options include a webcam privacy shutter. Additionally, two 360-degree mics with AI-based noise cancellation, combined with Dolby Voice® and Dolby Atmos® deliver a superb audio experience. Plus, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 is Zoom-certified. Make calls, listen to music, or watch a video and enjoy the sublime sounds.
You Spoke. We Listened: We’ve Redesigned Our Legendary Keyboard
Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard now includes tactile markings to help people with visual impairments more easily find the correct keys. We’ve moved the fingerprint reader to the keyboard, resulting in a larger sensor for a better experience. Plus, our TrackPad is even larger now, at 120mm / 4.72ʺ. Our beloved red TrackPoint still lets you navigate —  but with a double tap, it opens the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
A Feast for the Eyes
Razor-thin bezels frame an optional stunning 14ʺ 2.8K OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate. Sharp, clear details make content pop and colors more vibrant than ever on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop. But perhaps the best part yet? It’s easy on the eyes with Eyesafe® certification, so you can put in the long hours to meet your deadlines and not worry about eye-strain and fatigue.
Engineered for a No-Compromise Experience
The Intel® Evo™ Edition, ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop is engineered to do it all. Experience all-day battery life, instant wake, and best-in-class connectivity. No matter what tasks you tackle, this device is highly responsive. Plus, with Intel® Unison™, you can sync your laptop with any iOS or Android smartphone and then call or text, and even transfer files, photos, and videos all from the convenience of your PC.
Unleash Software Superpowers
Get the most out of your device with preinstalled Lenovo apps. Lenovo View is an AI-based camera app that enhances video quality and provides intelligent collaboration, privacy, and digital wellness features. Lenovo Vantage centralizes settings to safeguard data, automate updates, and improve performance — or Lenovo Commercial Vantage for IT manageability. We make it easier and safer to do your job well.
Stand Tough With Battle-Tested ThinkPad
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Your Face. Your Fingerprint. Your Fortress.
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop, from the fingerprint reader to facial recognition software. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, boasts discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to safeguard critical data with encryption. Plus, AI-powered Intel® Threat Detection Technology helps prevent ransomware, cryptojacking, and more. When it comes to security and protecting your assets, we’ve got you covered

Apple Pencil Pro adds even more magical capabilities to help bring your ideas to life. New advanced features make marking up, taking notes and creating a masterpiece more intuitive than ever.
Squeeze. Apple Pencil Pro can sense when you squeeze it and brings up a new palette, so you can quickly switch tools, line weights and colours.
Barrel roll. A new gyroscope allows you to rotate Apple Pencil Pro for precise control of shaped pen and brush tools.
Haptic feedback. A custom haptic engine provides precise feedback you can feel. When you squeeze or double tap, you’ll feel a light pulse confirming the action.
Apple Pencil hover.¹ Preview exactly where your Apple Pencil will touch down on your display and see a virtual shadow of your tool. So you can write, sketch and illustrate with even greater precision.
Double tap. Quickly switch between tools, like a pen and eraser, with a double-tap on Apple Pencil.
And if you misplace Apple Pencil Pro while you’re out and about or at home, you can easily locate it in the Find My app. Apple Pencil Pro attaches, pairs and charges magnetically on the side of your iPad.

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad NEW T14 Gen 4 (2023) 13Gen Intel Core i7 vPro 10-Cores Carbon Fiber w/ DDR5 Memory & Full HD+ Display
product_description:
Power, speed, & convenience
Powered by up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processing, the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop boasts high performance and blazing-fast memory, storage, and connectivity—it will zip through even your most demanding tasks. IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability, while everyone can get behind the added security with Intel vPro®.
Environmentally responsible
While the lightweight chassis is so convenient to carry around, it’s the sustainable materials that make owning this machine a true delight. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop is composed of 90% recycled magnesium on the C frame, and for the Storm Grey models, there’s 55% recycled aluminum on the D cover. Along with post-consumer content, recycled plastic in the enclosures for the speaker and battery, and the AC adapter, the packaging is plastic-free with 90% recycled and/or sustainable materials. Plus, the manufacturing process uses low-temperature soldering.
Easy on the eyes
If you spend hours on your laptop every day, you’ll need one that’s easy on the eyes. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 boasts a number of display options, ranging from a gorgeous 2.8K OLED with Dolby Vision® panel to lower resolution choices that offer touchscreens, PrivacyGuard, and various color gamuts. Plus, most of the displays feature low blue light certifications to help prevent eye fatigue. And with narrower bezels and a high screen-to-body ratio, everyone’s sure to appreciate the added screen real estate on this device.
Unleash your productivity
When you’re out on the road, you never know what the connectivity situation will be, or whether you’ll find an available electrical outlet. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop definitely keeps you covered in both regards! Lightning-quick WiFi keeps you online when wireless coverage is available—but if you’re out of range, you can also jump online just like a smartphone when you choose the WWAN* configuration.  What’s more, with the option of two battery sizes and rapid-charging technology, there’s little need to be tethered to an outlet. No matter where the business takes you, you’ll always be business-ready.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
Military-grade durability
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Security solutions tailored to you
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop— from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. Human-presence detection works with the infrared camera to automatically lock your device when you move away. And Intel vPro® helps prevent attacks on the OS, login credentials, and more.

The Lenovo ThinkPad E16 (16″ Intel) laptop exudes power, reliable performance, and robust security—for all of your business requirements. The stunning Graphite Black color gives the ThinkPad E16 (16″ Intel) laptop a modern, professional look. Tough enough to take anywhere
The ThinkPad E16 laptop is a good fit for remote work, thanks to its portable design and high battery capacity. product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 4 NEW Ryzen 7 Pro 7Gen 8-Core AI-Mobile Processors Heavy Lifter in a Lightweight Chassis w/ Touch Screen
product_description:
Heavy lifter in a lightweight chassis
With AMD Ryzen™ PRO 7040 Series featuring Ryzen™ AI mobile processors, the Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 4 laptop delivers some serious power to blaze through even your most demanding tasks. Whether you’re 3D rendering, exporting massive video files, or visualizing an architectural dream, these processors are built to beat the clock. Plus, with PRO security, PRO manageability, and PRO business-ready features, IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability — while everyone benefits from the added device security.
Protects you every step of the way
Optional biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad T14s Gen 4 laptop — from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the infrared (IR) camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. Human-presence detection works with the IR camera to automatically lock your device when you move away. Plus, AMD PRO Security delivers real-time, full-system memory encryption via AMD Memory Guard.
Responsibly made with recycled materials
While you’ll love the lightweight chassis, the recycled materials used in this machine are a real gem. The ThinkPad T14s Gen 4 laptop is composed of 90% recycled magnesium on the keyboard frame for the Deep Black models and 22% carbon fiber on the top cover. For the Storm Grey models, the top cover and keyboard frame include 50% recycled aluminum. Both models boast 55% recycled aluminum on the bottom cover, recycled plastic enclosures for the speaker, battery, and AC adapter, plus packaging made from 90% recycled and/or sustainable materials.
Easy on the eyes
If you spend hours on your laptop every day, you’ll love that it’s easy on the eyes. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 boasts a number of display options, ranging from a gorgeous 2.8K OLED with Dolby Vision® panel to lower resolution choices that offer touchscreens, PrivacyGuard, and various colour gamuts. Plus, most of the display panels feature low blue light certifications to help prevent eye fatigue. And with narrower bezels and a high screen-to-body ratio, everyone’s sure to appreciate the added screen real estate on this device. In addition, choose a 5MP camera for an enhanced video experience.
Business ready anywhere & everywhere
When you’re out on the road, staying connected and powered on is key. The ThinkPad T14s Gen 4 laptop keeps you covered in both regards. Blazing-fast WiFi keeps you online when wireless coverage is available—but if you’re out of range, you can connect just like a smartphone when you choose the optional 4G / LTE configuration.  What’s more, with all-day battery life, there’s little need to be tethered to an outlet. No matter where your business takes you, you’ll always be business-ready.
Designed for durability
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200 additional quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (2023) NEW 13Gen Intel Core i7 vPro 14-Cores Powerful ISV-Certified Mobile Workstation w/ Nvidia RTX 4080 12GB DDR6 & 2.5K IPS 165Hz  - Black
product_description:
Form meets function
The Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) is the perfect combination of form and function. Designed to be admired, its sleekness barely hints at what’s inside. A powerful system with the seamless performance of up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors and optional professional NVIDIA® discrete graphics.
Makes light work of heavy workloads
Certified by independent software vendors (ISVs), the Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) has been tested and proven to deliver efficient and seamless use of key applications. With this mobile workstation, you can rest easy knowing that it meet the demands of your business and your industry, wherever you need to work from.
See the complete list of ISV certifications
Visually captivating
With a large 16:10 aspect ratio screen, ideal for multitasking and larger workflows without sacrificing quality, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) gives you more bang for your buck. A content creator’s dream, this mobile workstation comes with a number of antiglare and TUV low-blue light display options, including an OLED touchscreen and factory color calibration for crisper, clearer images.
A webcam that’s got your front & back
The ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) boasts a hybrid FHD & infrared webcam as standard, so every videoconference is picture perfect. In addition, the webcam shutter and human presence detection helps to safeguard your privacy. You can also log in quickly and securely with just a smile via Windows Hello. And to further enhance your online meetings, there’s the option of a hybrid 5MP + infrared webcam.
The power to be free
For those who need to work from anywhere and need a workhorse that can plough through heavy computational workloads with ease, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) is ideal. As well as a myriad of ultra-fast memory and high performance storage, it boasts great WiFi connectivity and a large rapid-charging battery. The result? True on-the-go performance and power for anyone from designers to architects and VR/AR users to data scientists.
Productivity meets durability
The ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation is designed to meet your exacting needs. Its backlit, spill-resistant keyboard promotes faster, smoother typing. Its liquid metal design and vapor chamber offers advanced cooling to boost performance. It’s also MIL-SPEC certified and has passed more than 200 stringent Lenovo quality assessments, ensuring its reliability under pressure.
Security you can count on
The ThinkShield suite of hardware and software solutions is perfect for the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation, providing both device and key information security. Features include the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to encrypt your data and a biometric fingerprint reader for easy one-touch login. It also has the safety net of a self-healing BIOS to restore earlier system settings, if required.
Designed with the planet in mind
Engineered to reflect our commitment to the planet, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation includes recycled plastic, metal, and other materials. What's more, the packaging it comes in contains no plastic and 90% of it is sustainably made, including biobased and sustainably forested content.

product_name: Lenovo Legion Pro 7 Gen 9 (2024) 14Gen Intel Core i9 14900HX 24-Cores w/ Nvidia RTX 4080 12GB DDR6 & 16" 2.5K IPS 240Hz Display - Eclipse Black
product_description:
Game without compromise. Go beyond performance with Intel® Core™ processors
Intel® Core™ processors feature newly optimized hybrid architecture and industry-leading technology that enables you to go beyond gaming and creation. With Intel, you can do it all. From progressing in-game to advancing in real life, Intel empowers you to be your best self.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built for the era of AI, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the NVIDIA suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
Enjoy 3 months of Xbox Game Pass on Lenovo Legion devices
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new Lenovo Legion laptop and three months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with a connected controller. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms
Smarter gaming. Higher framerates. Lenovo AI Engine+.
The Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 gaming laptop is an esports beast, powered by the revolutionary LA-2Q + LA1 AI chip and Lenovo AI Engine+, making it smarter than ever.  In real-time, Lenovo AI Engine+ deploys a Smart Engine to optimize your game for maximum FPS by leveraging a host of system sensors across key components.  Further, Smart Engine gets better over time, ensuring your system can reach maximum performance to stay ahead of the competition, in and out of the arena, from the moment you unbox and for years to come.
Legion ColdFront: Vapor—Best-in-class thermal technology
Elevate your game with Legion ColdFront: Vapor’s AI augmentation, offering top-tier thermal technology for optimal performance in the esports arena.  The enhanced fan system with ultra-thin 3D fan blades ensures silent and smooth operation. A large intake and exhaust system optimizes airflow, boosting thermal efficiency for power-hungry games and software. It also features a colossal vapor chamber and GPU hybrid heat pipe tech. Infusion prevents throttling, keeping CPUs cool.
Display greatness
Quick-scope your enemies into oblivion on the cutting-edge Lenovo PureSight Gaming display, now X-Rite™ Pantone® Certified and factory-calibrated for incredible color accuracy. With a high 240hz variable refresh rate, this 16″ WQXGA 16:10 aspect ratio display makes the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 laptop perfect for big picture, fast reflexes, and accurate aim. The screen takes up 93.59% of the display's surface area, making it look like your picture is floating in space. Plus, 100% DCI-P3, HDR, and high color accuracy let you see every detail of your game, no matter how bright or dark the in-game environment gets.
Seize the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage allows you to optimize settings elevating your gaming experience. You can adjust, customize, and maximize your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls and AI-performance tuning with intelligent fan controls so nothing stands in the way of your success.
Play for the Green Team
Game responsibly with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9. Made from 50% recycled aluminum for the D cover, and 30% PCC for the A cover frame, this laptop is clean, environmentally and visually. The environmental ambient RGB lighting strip with AI light sync via Legion Spectrum makes it easy to customize your vibe and reacts to what's happening on your screen. Plus, a rear dashboard with full I/O support gives you all the connectivity you need.
Maxed out power
Enjoy unparalleled battery power with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 laptop. This bad boy is equipped with a 99.99Whr battery, the largest battery we can legally put into a laptop! Super Rapid Charge ensures the monster battery recharges in minutes with a 330W DC charger in the box and additional support for 140W USB-C* charging for on-the-go lifestyles. Additionally, Smart Battery v3.0 uses machine learning to preserve the battery's capacity and reduce deterioration.
*140W USB-C AC adapter sold separately
Control the battle
The Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 boasts the Legion TrueStrike gaming keyboard, the perfect set of controls for gamers who demand precision control—and great customization options. This full-sized keyboard also features full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large mylar touchpad that gives you everything you need to dominate. Fully customizable per-key RGB powered by Legion Spectrum gives you the power to create a stellar ambiance while you game. Plus, with 1.5mm key travel and support for swappable keycaps, you can create the perfect setup for your play style.
Immersive gaming with Tobii
Take control of the game using your head movements and experience a seamless expansion of your field of view. Tobii Horizon detects and tracks natural head movements via the built-in webcam. Additionally, get immersed in a new era of digital well-being with Tobii Aware for increased security, privacy, and productivity via smart features like auto-dimming, screen time tracking, privacy notifications, and auto-locking.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers, immersive 3D Audio
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic by SteelSeries on the Legion Pro 7i. Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game journey. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic doesn't just enhance your gaming—it immerses you in it.
Legion Arena, the ultimate gaming hub
Your games are all in one place. Legion Arena’s centralized gaming hub easily syncs with popular stores and gaming platforms to give you complete control over how you play, browse and manage your game library. You can access all your games in one place, no more switching between apps to find your favorite games.

Small & powerful
The ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 Small Form Factor (SFF) packs a lot of power in a space-saving business PC. With up to 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, speedy DDR4 memory, and loads of HDD and/or SSD storage, this small form factor (SFF) desktop will zip through any task for improved productivity.
Certified 'Earth-friendly'
Buy a new PC and give the Earth a break. The compact, durable ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 SFF is paint-free, with a chassis built from 35% post-consumer content and packaging that's 90% expanded polyethylene (EPE), which is easier to recycle than many other packing materials. And it comes with multiple green certifications and credentials, with select models and components that are Energy Star® 8.0-compliant and EPEAT® Gold-registered (where applicable*).
*Visit www.epeat.net for registration status by country.
Connectivity for any business need
A breeze to set up anywhere, the ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 Small Form Factor (SFF) is designed to bring you and your colleagues together, wherever you're working from. There are multiple front-and-back USB ports for peripherals and a range of video connection options—from VGA to DisplayPort to HDMI. Everything's smooth and fast, whether its’s connecting to other devices or collaborating online.
Cool & efficient—anywhere you work
With our Intelligent Cooling Engine (ICE) 6.0, system performance is optimized based on your workload. This enables superb energy efficiency, with over 40kwh per unit, per year in power savings. Additionally, the ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 SFF business PC has three operating modes for different workplaces, whether it’s an air-conditioned office, a hot restaurant kitchen, or a busy factory floor.
Upgradable. Expandable. Ready for anything.
Easy to upgrade and expand, the ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 desktop can be customized to meet your computing needs today and tomorrow. It's compact but still has space, including PCIe slots, for you to easily add extra graphics or storage. Or, with an optional Smart Cable, you can simply connect to another PC and leverage the additional storage capacity as you work seamlessly between two devices.
Built to deliver peace of mind
Engineered with security in mind, ThinkCentre Neo 50s Gen 4 SFF PC has the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 chip to encrypt your data and is integrated with ThinkShield, customizable end-to-end security for your PC and sensitive files. You can also use an optional Smart Cable Clip, padlock loop, or Kensington Security Slot™ to thwart physical theft, and Smart USB Protection to prevent data transfers via the USB ports

product_description:
PRO for professionals
With AMD Ryzen™ PRO 7000 Series Mobile Processors, the ThinkPad T16 Gen 2 laptop delivers some serious power to blaze through even your most demanding tasks. Whether you are exporting massive video files, or visualizing an architectural dream, these processors are built to beat the clock. Plus, with PRO security, PRO manageability, and PRO business-ready features, IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability — while everyone can benefit from the added device security.
Security that’s there when you need it — & when you don’t
Optional biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad T16 Gen 2 laptop — from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the infrared (IR) camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. Human-presence detection works with the optional IR camera to automatically lock your device when you move away. And with AMD PRO Security, you get real-time, full-system memory encryption via AMD Memory Guard — and more.
Makes personal computing even more personal
The ThinkPad T16 Gen 2 laptop is highly configurable. Between processor, memory, storage, and display options, this device offers nearly unlimited configurations, making it one of the most customizable computers on the market. With long battery life and rapid-charging technology*, you can confidently take to the road — and with ultrafast WiFi and the option of mobile connectivity, you won’t miss a beat.
*Available with the 52.5Whr battery.
Show your love for the planet
The ThinkPad T16 Gen 2 laptop features a number of environmentally responsible components including post-consumer content recycled plastic in the enclosures for the speaker, battery, and AC adapter. Packaging is 90% recycled and/or sustainable content, and the manufacturing process for essential parts uses low-temperature soldering. Available in Thunder Black or Storm Grey, both models feature 90% magnesium in the keyboard frame, while the Storm Grey version includes certified recycled aluminum (50% top cover, 55% bottom cover).
Big screen, big choices
If you spend lots of time on a PC, your eyes can become tired and strained. The massive 16″ display on the ThinkPad T16 Gen 2 helps to prevent that by offering panels with Eyesafe® certification for low blue light. Choose the stunning 4K OLED display with Dolby Vision® when every pixel counts, or go with lower resolution choices that offer touchscreens, low power, and various color gamuts. All screens feature narrower bezels and a high screen-to-body ratio, translating to added screen real estate.
Engineered to handle the extremes
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more

product_name: Lenovo ThinkCentre M70q Gen 5 Tiny (2024) 14Gen Intel Core i7 20-Cores Mini Size High-Herforming Business Desktop w/ Wireless & Bluetooth & 3 Years Warranty
product_description:
Compact yet full of potential
The Lenovo ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny (Intel) saves on space yet delivers on performance. Boasting full-sized desktop power with up to Intel vPro® with 13th Generation Intel® Core™ processors, this PC supports dual HDD and SDD storage. It also has option dual expansion ports that can be configured to meet your exact needs. Ideal for the modern professional, whether you're in healthcare, retail, or the front or back office.
Security inside & out
Every ThinkCentre lets you innovate fearlessly with the reinforced security of ThinkShield, our comprehensive end-to-end security solution. Combining industry-leading hardware, software, and services, it's designed to safeguard your data, ideas, and business. This Tiny desktop includes a self-healing BIOS, a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) to encrypt your data, and a Kensington Security Slot™ to physically secure your PC. And when you choose the Intel vPro® platform, you have additional multilayer, hardware-based protection.
Designed for today & tomorrow
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny (Intel) desktop is easy to deploy, upgrade, and manage. With toolless access to the solid state drive and memory module, it’s also a breeze to expand and maintain. What's more, this PC can connect with legacy computing peripherals and is designed to grow with your business.
As versatile as it is powerful
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny (Intel) is designed with people — and shrinking workspaces — in mind. Its sleek, modern design and compact 1L form allow this Tiny PC to fit seamlessly anywhere. It can sit on a desk, be mounted on a wall or out of the way, or slid snugly into the back of a ThinkCentre Tiny-in-One (TIO) monitor. It can also support up to four displays and its ports offer fast charging and quick data sharing.
It won’t let you down
Our dedication to constantly improving product quality means rigorous testing for durability and reliability. In addition to our extensive in-house testing for real-world challenges, the ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny desktop is tested against the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards. These tests cover harsh variables like the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms. It also meets stringent tests for temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Less impactful on the planet & users
The ThinkCentre M70q Gen 4 Tiny PC also meets various global standards for energy-efficiency and health & safety, including ENERGY STAR® 8.0 and EPEAT® Gold. Additionally, it’s been low-noise certified by TÜV Rheinland. It also comes with the option of ThinkCentre Tiny Dust Shield, which is easy to remove, wash, and replace, and helps to prolong the life of your PC.

product_name: ASUS TUF Gaming A16 Advantage Edition (2023) FA617NS NEW 7Gen AMD Ryzen 7 8-Cores w/ AMD RX 7700S 8GB & IPS 165Hz Display
product_description:
PERFORMANCE
AMD ADVANTAGE™
Jump right into the action with the TUF Gaming A16 Advantage™ Edition. Stream and multitask with ease thanks to the latest AMD Ryzen™ 9 7940HS CPU and up to 32GB of blisteringly fast 4800MHz DDR5 RAM on Windows 11. Leverage the full gaming performance of up to a AMD Radeon™ RX 7700S GPU with AMD Smart Access Graphics. When your game library gets full, an empty M.2 NVMe SSD slot makes upgrading storage capacity a breeze.
MUX SWITCHAMD SMARTACCESS GRAPHICS
AMD SmartAccess Graphics technology makes the most of every frame by automating switching between integrated and discrete graphics or gives you full manual control with a dedicated MUX switch.
AMD SMARTSHIFT MAX
AMD SmartShift Max is a dynamic boosting algorithm trained by machine learning that allows the CPU and GPU to automatically allocate power on the fly.
AMD SMART ACCESS MEMORY™
AMD Smart Access Memory™ gives the CPU access to the entirety of the GPU's VRAM rather than small chunks, reducing latency and improving performance.
AMD SMARTSHIFT RSR
The AMD SmartShift RSR allows the dedicated GPU to render a frame at a lower resolution, then upscale the frame with the integrated graphics for improved frame rates.
MORE MULTITASKING
Up to 32GB of dual-channel DDR5-4800 memory makes everything from multitasking to multimedia rendering run fast and smooth. High-performance RAM lets you switch between gaming, streaming, and web browsing seamlessly. Keep focused and keep active with no slowdowns in sight.
EXPANDABLE STORAGE
Games and apps load fast on the nimble NVM Express® (NVMe®) SSD. Speedier load times for all your programs means you can spend less time waiting and more time gaming. Take your must-play titles on the go with up to 2TB of PCIe® Gen4 storage, or add a second drive via the open M.2 SSD slot and make terabytes of space for a complete collection.
GAME. STREAM. CREATE.
The TUF Gaming A16 is built from the ground up for gamers — and, of course, game developers. The A16 can run all of the latest game engines, enabling you to unlock your creativity and try your hand at making something new. Whether you're a digital artist, streamer, video editor, or dabble with animation and game development, the A16 has all the horsepower you need to take your creations to the next level.
DISPLAY
SINK INTO THE SCENE
Never lose track of the action thanks to an immersive 16-inch panel with narrow bezels and a huge 90% screen-to-body ratio. Even in frenetic titles, the QHD 240Hz and FHD 165Hz refresh rates will let you keep up with the pros. With AMD FreeSync™ Premium, the display's refresh rate synchronizes with the GPU's output to reduce lag, minimize stuttering, and eliminate visual tearing for ultra-smooth and lifelike gameplay. The QHD panel hits 100% of the DCI-P3 color space and the FHD display covers 100% of sRGB, reproducing colors exactly as the creator intended.
THERMAL
INCREASED CAPACITY
High core count CPUs and modern GPUs create more heat when at full load. The TUF Gaming A16 is equipped to handle its high-power hardware with up to six dedicated heatpipes. The 2023 TUF Gaming A16 keeps its cool in even the most demanding games.
ARC FLOW FANS™
Slim chassis leave little room for cooling, so we enhanced every aspect of the Arc Flow Fans™. Each one features 84 blades that vary in thickness from base to tip to maximize airflow, and the blades are capped by a special aerodynamic wave pattern that minimizes turbulence and noise. Steady, evenly regulated airflow ensures greater reliability over time. The fans are made of a special liquid-crystal polymer that's strong enough to spin at high RPMs even at ultrathin sizes, enabling our highest blade density and improving airflow by up to 13%.
BLOW AWAY THE COMPETITION
Four dedicated exhaust vents and a high density heatsink allow the TUF A16 to keep total fan noise under 48dB when the system is in Turbo mode. The A16 stays cool and quiet during even the most intense gaming sessions.
DESIGN
THEY WILL NEVER SEE YOU COMING
The TUF Gaming A16 has a new color for 2023, designed to keep you off your enemy's radar. Inspired by the wastelands of battlefield, Sandstorm is the perfect paintjob for a military-grade laptop. The anodizing process that creates this light tan color provides a finish that's not only decorative, but durable and corrosion resistant, just like every TUF Gaming machine should be.
These laptops must successfully survive a rigorous battery of MIL-STD-810H* tests. Dependable even in the harshest conditions, the TUF Gaming A16 is more than capable of withstanding the accidental bumps and knocks of everyday life.
BATTERY
TAKE CHARGE
A 90Wh battery paired with the power-efficient AMD Ryzen™ processor provides up to 13.6 hours of video playback, with fast charging technology returning the machine to 50% charge in just 30 minutes. The A16 also supports up to 100W charging via USB-C, giving you flexibility on when and where you charge the machine on the go.
*Battery life may vary based on system configuration.
CONNECTIVITY
SAFE PORT IN A STORM
No matter your setup, the TUF Gaming A16 will keep you connected. A dedicated HDMI 2.1b port is supplemented by dual USB Type-C with DisplayPort support as well as the power and versatility of USB 4.0. For extra peripherals, the A16 also features one USB Type-A port on the left and right side, giving you flexibility no matter which hand is dominant. Fast and reliable Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) ensures that you'll be able to get online and enjoy lag-free gaming even on crowded networks, or you can wire up directly with gigabit Ethernet on-board.
*On selected model
AUDIO
CRYSTAL CLEAR COMMS
Two speakers powered by Dolby Atmos ensure a high-fidelity soundstage. Hi-Res Audio delivers music the way the artist intended over headphones. Two-way AI Noise Cancelation keeps incoming and outgoing communications clear of background noise, letting you focus on the action.
SOFTWARE
THE ULTIMATE COMMAND CENTER
Armory Crate software unifies system and lighting controls under a single, easy-to-use utility. Its extensive customization options let you personalize aesthetic effects, fine-tune game profiles, and adjust audio settings to fit your preferences. With Scenario Profiles, you can define and custom preferences that automatically adjust performance and other options when you launch your favorite apps and games. With Armory Crate, you take complete control of your experience

product_description:
Be bold. Do more on the move. The all-new TUF Dash F15 puts powerful Windows 11 gaming in a super slim chassis. Powered by Intel's latest 12th gen i7-12700H CPU, paired with Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 GPU make gaming smooth on up to a blazing fast 300Hz display. Even at 19.9mm thin, this TUF chassis meets rigorous MIL-STD durability standards, resisting everyday knocks and bumps. Up to 16.6 hours of battery lets you multitask more in a laptop light enough to carry into action anywhere.
Jump right into the action with the TUF Gaming F15. Running Windows 11 out of the box with an 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700H processor and 16GB of blisteringly fast 4800MHz DDR5 RAM, your streaming and multitasking are handled with ease. Leverage the full gaming performance of the GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU with a dedicated MUX Switch. When your game library gets full, an empty M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen 4x4 SSD slot makes upgrading storage capacity a breeze.
Keep up with the pros thanks to a FHD 300Hz panel. With Adaptive-Sync, the display’s refresh rate synchronises with the GPU’s output to reduce lag, minimise stuttering, and eliminate visual tearing for ultra-smooth and lifelike gameplay. The FHD display meets 100% of sRGB, reproducing colours exactly as the creator intended. Packed into an impressive 80% screen-to-body frame, videos and games will be even more immersive without sacrificing portability.
In order to earn the TUF Gaming name, these laptops must successfully survive a rigorous battery of MIL-STD-810H tests. Test devices are exposed to drops, vibration, humidity, and extreme temperatures to ensure reliability. Dependable even in the harshest conditions, the F15 is more than capable of withstanding the accidental bumps and knocks of everyday life.
High core count CPUs create more heat when at full load. The TUF Gaming F15 is equipped to handle its high-power CPU with a pair of 84-blade Arc Flow Fans. Our new variable thickness design has the dual benefit of increasing pressure while reducing turbulence, improving cooling performance without extra noise. When paired with up to four exhaust vents and five dedicated heatpipes, the 2022 TUF Gaming F15 keeps its cool in even the most demanding games.
Two speakers powered by Dolby Atmos ensure a high-fidelity soundstage. Hi-Res Audio delivers music the way the artist intended over headphones. Two-way AI Noise Cancellation keeps incoming and outgoing communications clear of background noise, letting you focus on the action.
A 90Wh battery paired with the power-efficient Intel processor provide up to 12.5 hours of web browsing and up to 12 hours of video playback, with fast charging technology returning the machine to 50% charge in just 30 minutes.

product_description:
Game without compromise. Go beyond performance with Intel® Core™ processors.
Intel® Core™ processors feature newly optimized hybrid architecture and industry-leading technology that enables you to go beyond gaming and creation. With Intel, you can do it all. From progressing in-game to advancing in real life, Intel empowers you to be your best self.
Beyond Fast
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built for the era of AI, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3.5 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the NVIDIA suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
This PC includes 3 months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new PC and 3 months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with connected controller. Details at xbox.com/gamepass.
Credit card required. After any promotional period, subscription continues automatically at regular price unless canceled. New subscribers only. Game titles, number, features, and availability vary over time, by region and platform. Limits, terms, and exclusions apply. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms.
Game Smarter, Create Better: AI-Tuned Excellence
Experience gaming like never before, where AI handles the heavy lifting. Embrace cutting-edge technology that evolves in sync with your passions. Powered by Lenovo AI Engine+ with the LA3 and LA1 AI chips, Legion 7i's Adaptive Performance feature continuously scrutinizes real-time sensor data, intelligently distributing resources to key components like CPU, GPU, and memory. Enjoy up to a 7% boost in gaming performance and a 24% improvement in DCC apps. With our Smart FPS feature, finding the optimal FPS for your games is effortless, enhancing performance by up to 15% at the flip of a switch.
Game Smarter, Game Cooler
Designed with gamers in mind, Legion ColdFront Hyper keeps your device cool by introducing innovative air pathways. With both fans spinning in opposite directions, cool air is guided inward through a central Hyper Chamber. Additionally, the sealed chamber ensures that hot air stays clear of the chassis, directing it out from the rear. This design eliminates the issue of hot air blowing onto your hand while using a mouse near the side vents—a true game-changer for uninterrupted play. You'll enjoy up to an extra 25W of power, a 2°C drop in skin temperature, and a 2dB reduction in noise.
Seize Every Pixel, Embrace Every Game
Ready to level up your gaming? The Lenovo Legion PureSight Gaming Display is your ticket to the big leagues. Choose from two high-res panel options—a crisp 3.2K with 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy or a sweeping WQXGA (2560 x 1600) with 240Hz refresh rate. You're in the game with the immersive 16:10 aspect ratio, a bezel-less design, and high refresh rates. And with VESA DisplayHDR™ 400 certification, you'll experience colors and contrasts like never before. Plus, we've got your back with TÜV Rheinland low blue light certification, reducing eye strain during those marathon gaming sessions. Time to unlock your gaming potential!
Keys to Precision & Comfort
Wield the Legion TrueStrike gaming keyboard, the perfect set of controls for gamers who demand precision, and customization options. This full-sized keyboard features full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large Mylar touchpad. Fully customizable RGB powered by Legion Spectrum and customizable color patterns with Legion Space give you the power to create a stellar ambiance while you game, as well as a white backlight when discretion is needed.
Design That Defies Limits
Welcome to the Legion 7i Gen 9 laptop, your stealthy gaming sidekick. With a sleek design crafted in anodized aluminum, it's ready to take on your daily routine. Portable, rugged, and available in Eclipse Black or Glacier White, it's your perfect partner for gaming adventures. Rear light-up ports make connections a breeze, even in low light. Your privacy? Sorted, thanks to the quick log-in fingerprint reader and a 1080p camera with an e-privacy shutter. Illuminate your keyboard’s extra functions with the Fn key. Stay in control with a power button that signals fan mode. So, why wait? Make the Legion 7i your gaming sidekick today.
Never Pause the Action
Packed with a robust 4-cell 99.99Whr battery, the Legion 7i Gen 9 laptop is a powerhouse that ensures you're never left hanging mid-game or during your creative endeavors. With Super Rapid Charge technology, you can charge up to 30% capacity in just 10 minutes or reach an impressive 70% capacity in a mere 30 minutes. In only 80 minutes, you'll have a full charge to fuel your gaming sessions. What's more, Legion 7i Gen 9 supports optional lightning-fast 140W USB-C charging, ensuring you spend less time plugged in and more time immersed in your favorite games or gaming live streams. Say goodbye to battery anxiety and hello to uninterrupted gaming and creation.
*140W USB-C AC adapter sold separately
Game With Speed & Space
With high-speed memory and efficient storage options, multitasking becomes a breeze, and you can enjoy a seamless experience while gaming, streaming, or tackling high-computing STEM coursework. With abundant 5600MHz DDR5 memory, you'll experience seamless multitasking and rapid load times for all your games and applications. Plus, with two SO-DIMM slots, you have room for future memory upgrades, ensuring your laptop remains future-proof. For storage, indulge in bountiful M.2 2280 PCIe Gen 4 storage, delivering incredible speed and responsiveness to your system.
Stay Connected & In Control
Stay connected and in control with Legion 7i's top-notch connectivity. Enjoy lightning-fast WiFi 6E for lag-free online gaming and seamless streaming. With Bluetooth 5.3, effortlessly pair all your Legion peripherals for a hassle-free experience. The Legion 7i is equipped with an array of ports, including two USB-A 3.2 and three USB-C ports, ensuring you can connect all your devices with ease. ThunderBolt™ 4 delivers blazing-fast data transfer speeds and supports 140W Power Delivery, while the HDMI 2.1 ensures high-quality video output. Additionally, the SD card reader 3.0 simplifies content transfer.
Gear Up, Game On
With Legion, you have the freedom to choose your gear, ensuring you're always ready for the next gaming adventure. Build your ultimate gaming setup with the Legion Y27h-30 monitor, Legion M300s RGB Gaming Mouse, Legion H200 Gaming Headset, Legion K300 RGB Gaming Keyboard, and the Legion Gaming Mouse Pad. It's your choice to go all out and create an ultimate gaming setup or keep it light and mobile with just the gaming mouse and the Legion Active Gaming Backpack, ensuring you can take your gaming prowess with you wherever you roam. Stay connected, stay in control, and stay ahead with Legion accessories that complement your gaming style.
*Accessories sold separately
Nahimic® Audio By SteelSeries for Gamers, Immersive 3D Audio
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic by SteelSeries on the Legion 7i Gen 9 laptop. Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game journey. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic doesn't just enhance your gaming—it immerses you in it.
Embrace the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage allows you to optimize settings to elevate your gaming experience. You can adjust, customize, and maximize your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls, and Custom Mode with fan control, nothing stands in the way of your success.
Maximize Your In-Game Immersion and Awaken Your Device
Tobii Horizon is a cutting-edge gearless head tracking software that allows you to experience a whole new level of immersion in an epic selection of games and game franchises.
** All accessories sold separately
A League of Power Players in Your Corner
Why not start every game with an A-team advantage? Harness the power of elite technicians who speak your language, and defeat bugs or flaws on command. Armed with an arsenal of tips and tricks, they’ll help you outwit your competition and go for gold.  Our team is here to help you 24/7 via chat, email, or phone. product_name: Lenovo ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 G4 (2024) Intel Core Ultra 7 12-Cores w/ Intel® AI Boost w/ Big Battery & Touch Screen Anti-FingerPrint - Luna Grey
product_description:
For Faster Processing & Performance
Optimised for a higher performance, the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop boasts exceptional AI capabilities. It is equipped with robust Intel® Core™ Ultra processors and combines the power of neural processing to expedite AI tasks. Whether writing code or making presentations — you can take full advantage of accelerated AI to improve your productivity. Plus, enjoy multitasking with superior battery performance that keeps you on the go all day and rapid charging when you need some juice. Get ready to enjoy the best AI PC experience.
Comfortable, Convenient & Always at Hand
Enjoy the versatility of a convertible laptop with the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4, which boasts the addition of the Lenovo Slim Pen. Magnetically attach it to the side of the keyboard and keep it conveniently within reach at your fingertips. Whether using it as a laptop or a tablet, get easy control for tasks like sketching, note-taking, navigation, or even signing a document with a bigger and more comfortable stylus.
See & Feel the Extraordinary
The hidden hinge design of the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop offers an immersive audio-visual experience. With ultra-narrow bezels and enlarged screen real estate, this convertible laptop shows its charm, and is ideal for work, school, and media. This multiuse laptop boasts several intelligent meeting features like auto-framing, noise cancellation, blur background, and more. Plus, it offers smart network connectivity, consistent audio supported by Dolby Atmos®, and exudes a classy appearance in Luna Grey.
Keystrokes — More Enjoyable & Convenient
The ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop boasts a revamped keyboard design with keys more comfortable to the touch. A spacious key layout ensures faster and more accurate typing, while also being highly resilient against dirt and spills. We’ve also added LED indicators on the microphone and speaker keys so it’s easy to see when they’re in use. But the best part? We’ve used 50% recycled post-consumer content (PCC) plastics in the keycaps and 50% recycled metal on the bottom cover — so you can feel good on multiple levels.
Become Flexibly Secure
Alongside security, the ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 laptop offers login flexibility to safeguard data with your fingerprint. The power button embeds an match-on-chip fingerprint reader that stores immutable credentials on a chip, while letting you safely log in and boot up in mere seconds. ThinkShield, our integrated suite of security offerings, encrypts data with discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM). Plus, with Windows facial recognition and the optional infrared (IR) camera, the system will instantly resume from hibernate or standby mode.
Designed to be Future-Proof
The ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 4 convertible laptop is an ideal choice for small-to-mid-sized businesses handling enterprise-level tasks. It offers ample responsive memory for multitasking and tackles demanding workloads with heavy data records. With its dual memory and storage slots, this versatile 2-in-1 laptop is engineered to adapt to changing future demands — you can easily upgrade your specs as your business grows, even without tech expertise. Simply remove the bottom cover for easy access to the upgradeable slots.

product_name: ASUS NEW Vivobook 15 (2022) X1504ZA NEW 12th Gen Intel Core i7 10-Cores Thin & Light Military-Grade - Silver
product_description:
Turn everyday tasks into something special with Vivobook 15, your essential tool for getting things done easier, anywhere. It’s completely user-friendly too, with its 180° lay-flat hinge and physical webcam shield. ASUS Antimicrobial Guard Plus protects frequently-touched surfaces from harmful bacteria, safeguarding your health. Make all your days more enjoyable with Vivobook 15!
Designed with help from the audio experts at Dirac, a professional audio solution provider, the audio system delivers the most immersive, clear, and balanced sound experience you’ve ever heard on a PC, laptop or tablet. You’ll hear a wider and deeper soundscape than you could imagine, unleashing the full audio potential of your laptop.
Vivobook 15 has a lid with a special raised logo tag, and it’s available in your choice of three eye-catching colors: charming Quiet Blue, Transparent Silver, or cozy Terra Cotta — just pick your favorite! It’s slim enough to pop unobtrusively into any backpack, and light enough for easy one-handed carrying.
Inhibit 99% of flu virus & bacteria
ASUS Antimicrobial Guard Plus is applied to frequently touched areas of your laptop to help keep it hygienic. This technology uses a denser treatment that inhibits viruses and bacteria. And it is scientifically shown — using the ISO 2170211 and 2219612 standards — to inhibit virus and bacteria growth by more than 99% over a 24-hour period
* Treatments14 are approved by US FIFRA15 & EU BPR16.
Vivobook 15 features a precision-engineered, lay-flat hinge that makes it easy to share content with others, or collaborate with a group of people around a table.
Vivobook 15 keeps you fully connected with its comprehensive I/O ports. There are one USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 port, two USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A ports, a USB 2.0 port, HDMI output and an audio combo jack — so it’s easy to connect all your existing peripherals, displays and projectors.
ASUS is committed to driving progress toward a more sustainable future. Vivobook 15 incorporates sustainable materials in the product and its packaging. Top ecolabels and compliance, ENERGY STAR, and RoHS, prove our commitment to protecting the earth and giving you the best.

Business power with an earth-friendly spin
Go high and low with the ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower. For high performance, choose up to a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ CPU—with more processing cores than earlier versions. Cool, quiet productivity
You’ll hear and feel the difference. Equipped with the Intelligent Cooling Engine (ICE) 6.0, power consumption is optimised to keep the system cool—even when you’re working hard. Multiple operating modes are suited to different business settings. Fan sounds and ambient noise are minimised, too.
New ways to share & collaborate
Collaboration is fast and easy on the ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower. Wired and wireless connectivity—up to WiFi 6—makes sharing project ideas a breeze. Remote meetings are a snap thanks to Windows 11 Pro and Microsoft Teams integration. And attaching an optional Smart Cable opens a world of possibilities, including connecting to another PC to leverage its storage and other components.
Device & data security
The ThinkCentre Neo 50t Gen 4 Tower is protected by our ThinkShield security solutions—a suite of hardware and software that work together to safeguard both your device and your data. From discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that encrypts your passwords, to physical security options, to a self-healing BIOS with BIOS Guard and Boot Guard, to smart USB protection — we’ve got you covered.

product_description:
13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Beyond performance.
Intel's latest hybrid architecture, paired with industry-leading features, delivers the ultimate gaming experience. Stream, create and compete at the highest levels – 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors push your gameplay beyond performance, giving you the power to do it all.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 20 Series Laptop GPUs are beyond fast for gamers and creators. They're powered by the ultra-efficient NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture, which delivers a quantum leap in both performance and AI-powered graphics. Experience lifelike virtual worlds with ray tracing, massively boost performance with DLSS 3, and get a competitive edge with Reflex. Discover revolutionary new ways to create and unprecedented workflow acceleration. Plus, the Max-Q suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
Enjoy 3 Months of Xbox Game Pass on Lenovo LOQ Devices
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new Lenovo LOQ laptop and three months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with a connected controller. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms
The power of AI-fueled gaming
Get ahead of the game with Lenovo AI Engine+, equipped with LA1 AI chip for a finely tuned system that uses sensors to enhance your gaming experience. A dedicated MUX Switch with NVIDIA® Advanced Optimus reduces latency, optimizes battery life, and increases FPS. Smart Engine technology keeps you on top of your game so you can unlock your true potential.
Play hard, run quiet
Move in silence and game loud with Lenovo LOQ's whisper-quiet thermal solution. Its innovative design includes up to 4 heat pipes, dual 85mm 12V high-speed fans, 28.6% larger air intake, and 24% larger outlet vents. With generous ventilation and up to 135W TDP, your gaming rig will stay cool and quiet even in public areas or library quiet zones. Enjoy uninterrupted gaming sessions without drawing unwanted attention. Upgrade to Lenovo LOQ 15IRH8 and keep your gaming sessions discreet.
Rugged design, simplicity fueled
The Lenovo LOQ 15IRH8 laptop sports a rugged, practical, sleek design and a signature gaming rear I/O dashboard. It comes with a wide array of ports for easy access and a clean look. Available in Storm Grey with a built-in 720P or 1080P camera sporting an e-privacy shutter for greater privacy. Built to strict MIL-STD 810H US military-grade standards for ultimate durability, this laptop is as tough as the characters you play as.
Greatness on display
Elevate your gaming experience on a 15.6″ WQHD display. Your games will come to life with a lightning-fast 165Hz variable refresh rate, lifelike colors with 100% sRGB and a bright 350-nit screen. Plus, DC dimming ensures low power consumption, helping extend battery life for those long gaming sessions on the go. Get lost in the game and upgrade your display game with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRH8 laptop.
Dominate with ergonomic precision and accuracy
Unlock your ultimate typing and gaming potential with the Lenovo LOQ keyboard. With classic tactile touch-feel and 1.5mm key travel, you'll enjoy lightning-fast actuation and 100% anti-ghosting for unmatched accuracy. The full-sized arrow keys and number pad help you stay in control in any scenario. Plus, the optional 4-zone RGB backlighting lets you add some gaming sauce to your setup.
Future-proof expandability
Upgrade your gaming experience with limitless expandability on the Lenovo LOQ 15IRH8 laptop. With up to 32GB of DDR5 memory and 1TB of PCIe Gen4 storage, you can switch between gaming, streaming, and creating without any lag or slow boot-up times. Plus, with 2 SSD slots and an open M.2 slot, you can easily add a second drive for even more storage. No need to delete your favorite games anymore!
Charge up your game
Push your battery life to its max and embrace the industry-shaking Super Rapid Charge. Charge up your 60Whr battery in a heartbeat—from 0 to 30% in 10 minutes, 0 to 70% in 30 minutes, and 0 to 100% in 80 minutes. With support for powerful 140W charging via USB-C, you'll have all the power you need when you need it, so you can focus on owning the competition instead of finding an outlet.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers
Elevate your gaming experience with Nahimic by SteelSeries, designed specifically for gamers. Enjoy unparalleled immersive 3D audio and crystal-clear communication with your teammates. With the ability to mix and share audio streaming like a pro, Nahimic allows you to immerse yourself in your games and truly live them fully.
Secure the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage helps you optimize settings to elevate your gaming experience. You can adjust, customize, and maximize your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls, and AI-performance tuning with intelligent fan controls, nothing stands in the way of your success.

product_description:
With a 10.2” 300 ppi glare-free Paperwhite display, Kindle Scribe is perfect for reading and writing, even in direct sunlight. The large display gives you room to take notes and journal, and makes it easy to adjust font size and margin width for improved reading comfort. Writing on Kindle Scribe feels like writing on paper. From the natural grip of the pen in your hand, to the sound you hear when you write, Kindle Scribe’s surface is crafted for the best possible reading and writing experience.Learn more about what else you can do with Kindle Scribe.
Kindle Scribe includes either a Basic or Premium Pen. Both give you more ways to use your Kindle than ever before. The Premium Pen has a dedicated eraser and a shortcut button, which can be assigned to seamlessly switch between pen, highlighter, and more.
No charge or setup required
Attaches magnetically
Dedicated eraser (PremiumPen only)
Shortcut button (PremiumPen only)
Create handwritten sticky notes in millions of eBooks from the Kindle Store without cluttering up the page. Simply tap where you want to insert a note on the page to quickly capture that handwritten thought for later. Sticky notes are automatically organized by book, into one place, so you can easily navigate, browse, and export all your in-book notes.
A pen and highlighter are always handy but sometimes you need more options. Try the fountain pen for beautiful calligraphy, switch to marker to emphasize your notes, or use the pencil for light sketching. Some writing tools feature enhanced pressure and tilt capabilities.
With the lasso select tool resize, move, cut, copy, or paste your notes within and across notebooks and books.
Securely import files to your Kindle Scribe through Send-to-Kindle in your desktop web browser, with the “Share” button of the Kindle app for iOS and Android, or directly through Microsoft Word (Microsoft 365 subscription required). Mark up PDF files imported in original layout, or insert sticky notes on imported Microsoft Word documents and other compatible Send-to-Kindle file formats.
Easily convert, edit and send your handwritten notebooks as text to your colleagues and friends. Share via email to use in documents or presentations.
Kindle Scribe is also a notebook and a journal with included templates like lined paper, planners, to-do lists, and more. Stop searching through stacks of paper, keep notes organized in folders and subfolders, and now view several pages of your notebooks at once with notebook overview. Access your notebooks through the Kindle mobile app.
Adjustable warm light and auto-adjusting front light provide a comfortable, personalized reading and writing experience, day or night. And with USB-C charging and a battery life that lasts months for reading and weeks for writing, you can immerse yourself in your content without the worry of finding a power outlet.

product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad L13 YOGA Gen 4 13Gen Intel Core i7 10-Core Business Class 2-in-1 Touch Screen - Thunder Black
product_description:
Speedy & powerful = a winning combo
Powered by up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processing, the ThinkPad L13 Yoga Gen 4 convertible laptop inspires productivity. It’s thin, light, and quick in all that it does — including an instantaneous boot up and log in, with a power button activated by an optional fingerprint reader. Plus, it boasts plenty of storage and fast memory. With optional Intel vPro®, IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability.
We’ve got you covered 24/7
ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Optional biometrics provide extra protection — from the fingerprint reader to the facial recognition software that works with the infrared (IR) camera. Discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypts your critical data, while optional Intel vPro® helps prevent attacks to the OS, login credentials, and more.
Takes flexibility to the max 
Thanks to its 360-degree hinge, the ThinkPad L13 Yoga Gen 4 convertible quickly switches between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes. No matter where your work takes you, we’ve got a way to accommodate your style and help get things done, faster. Seamlessly go from typing on the keyboard to sketching, signing documents, or taking notes on screen with the garaged pen. Or just swipe when you’re using the device as a tablet. And if you want to share your screen for collaboration, it literally bends over backwards for you.
Feel good about your laptop & your bottom line
At Lenovo, we provide all the tools you need to keep your business running, while also assuring we use recycled materials as much as possible. For the ThinkPad L13 Yoga Gen 4 2-in-1 laptop, we start with post-consumer content recycled plastic on the top covers. Likewise with key components, including the battery and speaker enclosures, and the AC adapter. We manufacture with low-temperature soldering for significant pieces and the packaging is 90% recycled and/or sustainable content. We’ve also earned the Energy Star® certification.
Laptop, tablet, phone?!
With Intel® Unison™, you can put your laptop at the center of all that you do. Wirelessly connect your phone — either Android or iOS — to your ThinkPad L13 Yoga Gen 4 2-in-1 laptop. Transfer files quickly and easily, even edit your photos and videos seamlessly on the big screen. Make and answer calls directly from your PC, with full access to your phone’s contact list. You can even receive notifications on your laptop, as well as messaging. No need to switch devices when you can do it all in one place.
Designed with durability in mind
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.

Creativity translator
The Lenovo ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop is ideal for creative professionals and businesses. Powered by 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, the 16p boasts high performance, and blazing-fast memory, storage, and connectivity. Add to that NVIDIA® GeForce RTX® graphics, and you’re ready to master whatever workloads hit your desk. Enhanced thermals with a dual-fan design and four vents keep airflow circulating to ensure the system runs cool.
Creature comforts
Along with the sleek look and feel of the aluminum chassis, the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop boasts an upgraded ergonomically redesigned keyboard. With an integrated smart backlight, the ambient light sensor automatically adjusts the amount of light needed so even working in dimly lit places won’t deter your productivity. The touchpad is much larger than previous generations, and it’s made with a glass surface—so navigating feels smooth and easy.
Take your online meetings to the next level
When it comes to virtual collaboration, the Lenovo Magic Bay optional suite of modular accessories enhance your experience. Made exclusively for the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop, each of these pocket-sized devices magnetically attaches to the top of the display and via a pogo-pin. Lenovo Magic Bay LTE ensures 4G access as long as there’s mobile coverage*. The 4K Webcam with 30FPS, autofocus, autoframing, and adjustable viewing angles captures you at your best. And the Magic Bay Light illuminates any dim area and even powers on automatically when the laptop’s camera turns on.
*Availability varies by region and requires a network service provider.
Respects the planet
The ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop sports a series of sustainability certifications such as EPEAT® Gold (select countries), ENERGY STAR® 8.0, and TCO 9—the world-leading environmental certification for IT products. Sustainably sourced packaging is certified by the Forest Stewardship Council® (FSC). You can even decrease your carbon footprint with the Lenovo CO2 Offset Service. But the best part, perhaps, is that various components are made from post-consumer content, with 50% recycled aluminum on the keyboard frame (C side) and 30% recycled plastic on the AC adapter.
24/7 security
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop— from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to ensuring your system is protected. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. There’s even a self-healing BIOS should it become corrupted.
When every pixel matters
The ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop features amazing display options up to a 3.2K 3200 x 2000 resolution that also includes X-Rite® Factory Display Calibration and 100% DCI-P3 color gamut. Vibrant and rich visuals render true to life with Dolby Vision® whether your editing videos or creating multimedia. What’s more, TÜV Eyesafe® low blue light certification means that even when working long hours, the likelihood of eye fatigue or strain is significantly decreased.

product_description:
13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Beyond performance.
Intel®’s latest hybrid architecture paired with industry-leading features delivers the ultimate gaming experience. Stream, create, and compete at the highest levels, as 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors push your gameplay beyond performance, giving you the power to do it all.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs are beyond fast for gamers and creators. They're powered by the ultra-efficient NVIDIA® Ada Lovelace architecture, which delivers a quantum leap in both performance and AI-powered graphics. Experience lifelike virtual worlds with ray tracing, massively boost performance with DLSS 3, and get a competitive edge with Reflex. Discover revolutionary new ways to create and unprecedented workflow acceleration.
This PC includes 3 months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new PC and 3 months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with connected controller.
Credit card required. After any promotional period, subscription continues automatically at regular price unless canceled. New subscribers only. Game titles, number, features, and availability vary on over time, by region and platform. Limits, terms, and exclusions apply. Details at Xbox.com/gamespass.
Thermal thrust, not throttle
Slimline laptops shouldn’t mean throttled performance. With Lenovo Legion ColdFront 5.0, you can focus on what matters the most – gaming and creating – and not have to worry about your device overheating. The Lenovo Legion Slim 5i is loaded with advanced technologies for quiet and ultra-cool gameplay, such as a phase change thermal compound, much larger hybrid copper heat pipes and fins, increased air intake and exhaust, and a turbo-charged dual liquid crystal polymer fan system.
A synthesis of sleek & sport
Weighing under 2.3kg and measuring as thin as 19.7mm, this powerhouse laptop boasts serious toughness. The perfect balance of strength and style, the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i houses a powerful engine in its sleek chassis, and is available in Storm Grey. With a 1080p webcam with e-shutter, rear I/O dashboard, and SD card reader, this device makes it easy to capture and share your vision.
PureSight, pure power, pure passion
Step up your gaming and content creation visuals with the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i laptop’s 16″ 16:10 WQXGA Lenovo PureSight gaming display. A blazing-fast up-to 165Hz refresh rate and NVIDIA® G-Sync® support makes for smooth, lag-free gameplay. Plus, with X-rite technology on select models, you’ll be able to pick out every detail in stunning clarity. Elevate your display to the next level with a wide color gamut, plenty of screen real estate with 93% AAR, and incredible resolution.
Die-hard battery
The Lenovo Legion Slim 5i packs a whopping up-to 80Whr battery that will keep you fully charged and ready to conquer new worlds in record time. With the Super Rapid Charge technology, get your battery to 70% capacity in just 30 minutes or reach 100% in 80 minutes with the optional 140W USB-C charger. Plus, Smart Battery 3.0 ensures maximum capacity retention and longevity with lifespan predictions, health maintenance, and peak power performance.
*Laptops include a 170W or 230W power adapter.  Optional 140W USB-C power adapter sold separately.
Lenovo AI Engine+ turbocharged by Lenovo LA1 AI chip
Unleash the full potential of your gaming with the unbeatable Lenovo AI Engine+. Equipped with the Lenovo LA1 AI chip, this powerful engine is ready to deliver supercharged gaming. Whether you’re gaming at home or on the go, with the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i, the intelligent and intuitive system features sensors that dynamically allocate wattage between CPU and GPU to optimize performance and minimize fan noise.
Deadly accuracy, pure purpose
Get ready to unleash pure precision and power with the legendary Lenovo Legion TrueStrike keyboard. Engineered with a massive mylar trackpad, numpad, and full-sized arrow keys, this keyboard is crafted for elevated gaming and creative mastery. Its 1.5mm travel distance makes for smooth key presses, while interchangeable keycaps and Legion Spectrum 4-zone RGB keyboard lets you customize your experience to your liking.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers, immersive 3D audio
Nahimic® by SteelSeries drastically improves your gaming experience on the Legion Slim 5i by providing unprecedented immersive 3D audio made for gamers. Discover crystal-clear communication with your teammates, allowing you to use a simple way of mixing and sharing audio streaming journeys like a professional streamer. Nahimic® doesn’t just let you play your games – it lets you live them.
Embrace the Lenovo Vantage
Get the optimal settings for your next gaming session. Lenovo Vantage allows you to adjust, customize, and maximize your Legion Slim 5i laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls, and AI-performance tuning with intelligent fan controls, nothing stands in the way of your success.
Legion Ultimate Support
Legion Ultimate Support is here to be your META – Most Effective Tactic Available. With one point of contact, get 24/7 gamer-centric support from a team of IT and gaming experts who can help optimize your hardware and software settings. Legion Ultimate Support pros will keep you productive all day and unbeatable at night.
Legion Arena, the ultimate gaming hub
Browse and manage your games all in one place. Legion Arena’s centralized gaming hub easily syncs with your favorite stores and gaming platforms to give you complete control over how you play. Say goodbye to switching between apps when trying to find your favorite games.

product_name: Lenovo ThinkStation P3 Ultra SFF Workstation (2023) 13Gen Intel Core i9 EVO 24-Cores Superior Performance w/ NVIDIA® T1000 8GB GDDR6 - Black
product_description:
Superior performance, smaller footprint
The Lenovo ThinkStation P3 Ultra boasts a revolutionary 3.9L form factor in a space-efficient chassis. Ideal for demanding workflows that require flexible configurations and maximum space savings, it’s designed to go wherever today’s professionals need to be. Powered by 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors and with a choice of optional latest NVIDIA® discrete graphics, this workstation breaks new ground with an intelligently compact design that doesn’t compromise on functionality.
Configurable for today & tomorrow
No matter how heavy or complex your workflow needs are, the ThinkStation P3 Ultra can be configured to meet them—now and well into the future. With support for up to 128GB of memory and 9TB of storage, plus an array of high-speed ports, including three DisplayPorts and dual ethernet ports, this workstation packs an unimaginable level of power and performance.
Makes your workflows flow
The ThinkStation P3 Ultra, with its optimal size and performance, is perfect for any industry, from architecture to healthcare and finance to education. MIL-SPEC-certified, it runs in even the most extreme conditions, from the Arctic to deserts. It also zips through high-performance workflows, such as CAD and Edge/IoT. And with its extensive list of ISV-certified applications, your most complex projects will be executed with ease.
See the complete list of ISV certifications
Remote management, made easy
The ThinkStation P3 Ultra supports the pluggable baseboard management controller (BMC)*. A specialized service processor, BMC uses sensors to track the physical condition of hardware such as PCs and network servers. It enables advanced remote monitoring and systems management, including installing BIOS updates and monitoring fan speeds, in this critical time of digital transformation.
All the security you need
The ThinkStation P3 Ultra comes with ThinkShield—a suite of hardware and software designed to safeguard both your workstation and data. It includes essential security features like Trusted Platform Module (TPM) to encrypt your sensitive data and programs to prevent unauthorized system access. It also has a self-healing BIOS should the BIOS be corrupted or maliciously attacked. For extra peace of mind, this PC supports Windows firmware updates.
