product_name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (2024) Intel Core Ultra 7 H-Serise Powerful 16-Cores w/ Intel® AI Boost NPU & OLED 2.8K 120Hz Display - Black
product_description:
How Do You Show Respect for the Planet?
The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (14ʺ Intel) laptop still uses carbon fiber for the chassis — but better yet some of that carbon fiber is recycled from post-industrial remnants and is used along with 90% recycled magnesium. Plus, the chassis, the battery pack, the speaker enclosure, and the power adapter all include recycled post-consumer content. And we don’t stop there. The packaging is 100% plastic-free and comprised in part with rapid-renewable materials made from bamboo-sugar-cane fiber.
Elevated Performance & Lasting Battery
The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 boasts the world’s first laptop powered by Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, making it ideal for creating and on-the-go productivity. Enjoy optimized performance with workloads pushed to dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) for sustained tasks and resilient battery life. Go ahead, turn on auto-framing or low-light enhancement for your online meetings, even when unplugged! Choose the Intel vPro® Evo™ Edition, for multilayer security, professional-grade performance, reliable stability, and complete management for IT.
Raise the Bar on Collaboration
A Communications Bar, positioned at the top of the display for easy laptop opening, houses two cameras (FHD / infrared (IR)) — or upgrade to the premium 8MP & IR Mobile Industry Processor Interface (MIPI) with Computer Vision — both options include a webcam privacy shutter. Additionally, two 360-degree mics with AI-based noise cancellation, combined with Dolby Voice® and Dolby Atmos® deliver a superb audio experience. Plus, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 is Zoom-certified. Make calls, listen to music, or watch a video and enjoy the sublime sounds.
You Spoke. We Listened: We’ve Redesigned Our Legendary Keyboard
Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard now includes tactile markings to help people with visual impairments more easily find the correct keys. We’ve moved the fingerprint reader to the keyboard, resulting in a larger sensor for a better experience. Plus, our TrackPad is even larger now, at 120mm / 4.72ʺ. Our beloved red TrackPoint still lets you navigate —  but with a double tap, it opens the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
A Feast for the Eyes
Razor-thin bezels frame an optional stunning 14ʺ 2.8K OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate. Sharp, clear details make content pop and colors more vibrant than ever on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop. But perhaps the best part yet? It’s easy on the eyes with Eyesafe® certification, so you can put in the long hours to meet your deadlines and not worry about eye-strain and fatigue.
Engineered for a No-Compromise Experience
The Intel® Evo™ Edition, ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop is engineered to do it all. Experience all-day battery life, instant wake, and best-in-class connectivity. No matter what tasks you tackle, this device is highly responsive. Plus, with Intel® Unison™, you can sync your laptop with any iOS or Android smartphone and then call or text, and even transfer files, photos, and videos all from the convenience of your PC.
Unleash Software Superpowers
Get the most out of your device with preinstalled Lenovo apps. Lenovo View is an AI-based camera app that enhances video quality and provides intelligent collaboration, privacy, and digital wellness features. Lenovo Vantage centralizes settings to safeguard data, automate updates, and improve performance — or Lenovo Commercial Vantage for IT manageability. We make it easier and safer to do your job well.
Stand Tough With Battle-Tested ThinkPad
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Your Face. Your Fingerprint. Your Fortress.
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 laptop, from the fingerprint reader to facial recognition software. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, boasts discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to safeguard critical data with encryption. Plus, AI-powered Intel® Threat Detection Technology helps prevent ransomware, cryptojacking, and more. When it comes to security and protecting your assets, we’ve got you covered

Lenovo Flex 5i features up to 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i7, from a range of CPUs specifically engineered for thin and light laptops. You can even edit video while you video chat with the confidence your device will run cool and silent under any conditions.
360 degrees of freedom
Whether you need to work, play, or share, the IdeaPad Flex 5i rotates into tent or stand mode for entertainment and presentations, or tablet mode for life on the go. The rugged drop-down hinge gently lifts the keyboard to cover the bottom display bezel for a more ergonomic typing experience while increasing the screen-to-body ratio for a more immersive display.
Sharp & piercing clarity
The 14″ screen feels larger than it is, thanks to the WUXGA IPS display's sharp contrast and piercing clarity. The photorealistic color brings entertainment vividly to life. Fun & productivity rolled into one speedy package
Ready for a fast-charging PC? A rapid charge boost gives you two hours of battery life in just 15 minutes. Log in securely and seamlessly via a fingerprint sensor. Connect up to two 4K monitors with Thunderbolt™ 4.0 universal connectivity, which offers a compatible dock and faster data transfers. Plus, write or sketch away with the included Lenovo Digital Pen.
Constantly evolving AI
A smarter PC for your ever-changing needs. Lenovo’s AI engine uses a machine learning algorithm to enhance your device’s performance. That means continually fine-tuning the variables. Deploy smart power to seamlessly switch between Quiet, Balance, and Performance modes according to your workflow, giving you the optimum balance between performance and battery life.
Rugged style, from the inside out
Designed around a convertible chassis centered on a 360° hinge that’s scrupulously tested to ensure it can stand up to the toughest jobs. Its ultrathin and light body weighs just 1.5 kg / 3.31 lbs for exceptional portability and convenience. Along with its modern styling, the IdeaPad Flex 5i features a sleek case with a metal cover and is available in Arctic Grey and Abyss Blue.

product_description:
Takes productivity to the next level
Co-engineered with Intel®, the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 meets Intel® Evo™ laptop design requirements, hardware specifications, and key user experience targets for consistent responsiveness, instant wake, all-day battery life, fast charging, and intelligent video conferencing. This Evo-certified device also includes Intel® Unison™ for seamless connectivity with your Android or iOS smart phone for calling, messaging, and file and photo sharing—all done from your laptop.
Collaborating remotely never looked or sounded so good
The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop includes a highly functional and stylish Communications Bar, which houses an FHD camera or a hybrid FHD and infrared (IR) camera. Or go big with the FHD / IR mobile industry processor interface (MIPI) webcam with Computer Vision’s added security. And, of course, all cameras include the webcam privacy shutter. What’s more, 4 x 360-degree mics with integrated AI-based noise cancellation and Dolby Voice® deliver superb audio. With the quality of video calls this amazing, you may never want to commute to an office again.
Effortless connection with your phone
With Intel® Unison™, you can put your laptop at the center of all that you do. Wirelessly connect your phone—either Android or iOS—to your ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop. Transfer files quickly and easily, even edit your photos and videos seamlessly on the big screen. Make and answer calls directly from your PC, with full access to your phone’s contact list. You can even receive notifications on your laptop, as well as messaging. No need to switch devices when you can do it all in one place.
Bumps up the coolness factor
The legendary ThinkPad keyboard is designed for ergonomics and comfort—and part of that comfort means improved airflow. The underside of the keys facilitates air intake when in use. Combined with the dual fan and rear venting, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 notebook delivers improved thermals. So whether you’re powering through your day, or your night, or both, the ThinkPad X1 will stay as cool as you are.
Vibrant visuals that suit your needs
No matter how you look at it, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 laptop features stunning displays that meet your workday needs. Whether you require richly detailed graphics with super-high screen resolution, or extra security to combat prying eyes, we’ve got options for you. Ranging from a widescreen ultra extended graphics array (WUXGA) touchscreen to a 2.8K OLED display, to a WUXGA with ePrivacy, all of the 14ʺ panels feature a 16:10 aspect ratio with maximum screen real estate. What’s more, almost all selections include Eyesafe® certification to reduce eye fatigue.
Security that works 24/7
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 system—from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to all our business laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) safeguard your critical data with encryption. Presence detection automatically locks your device when you move away, while the optional PrivacyGuard display prevents wandering eyes from seeing what’s on your screen.
Trusted ThinkPad quality
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Feel good about the planet
At Lenovo, we take sustainability seriously. We’ve committed to net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, making us the world’s first PC and smartphone maker and one of only 139 companies with a net-zero target validated by Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). For the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11, that means low-temp soldering and 90% recycled magnesium on the C cover. We use 98% post-consumer content (PCC) recycled plastic in the speaker enclosure, 25-30% PCC recycled plastic in the battery enclosure, and 90% PCC recycled plastic in the power adapter. Packaging is entirely plastic-free.
Zoom certification
Being Zoom certified means exceptional experiences under all the Zoom offerings. From meeting spaces and webinars to events and team chats. From booking conference rooms to sending email. From virtual customer service agents to driving loyalty and retention. From leveraging AI to mine customer conversations to delivering a platform for developers. The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 raises the bar for interactions with Zoom One, Zoom Spaces, Zoom Contact Center, Zoom IQ for Sales, and Zoom Developers.

product_description:
Premium power
The sleek design of the ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 mobile workstation hints at what’s inside: a powerful system that offers the professional performance of the latest Intel vPro® platform with Core™ H Series processors and graphics support up to NVIDIA® RTX™ A5500 GPU. Combine this with ISV certification by industry-leading software vendors, and your applications will blaze through heavy workloads.
Learn more about ISV certification.

Powerful, mobile, and visually stunning, the P1 Gen 5 mobile workstation is the perfect combination of form and function. A liquid metal thermal design improves cooling performance, while the optional Carbon-Fiber Weave looks stunning. This device is designed to be taken out into the world.
Content creator’s dream come true
Boasting a 16″ panel, narrow bezel, and a 16:10 aspect ratio for increased screen real estate, the ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 is designed with the modern user in mind.  With its low blue light displays, Dolby Vision®, and X-Rite Factory Color Calibration for crisp, clear images, this device is easy on the eyes.
Keeps your data—& privacy—safe
The ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 laptop starts with our ThinkShield security suite, preloaded to protect your device and data. From discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) to encrypt your data to a fingerprint reader with biometrics for a simple touch log in, and a self-healing BIOS that can restore earlier system settings when needed, we’ve got you covered.
Built to withstand the worst
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.

product_description:
Game without compromise. Go beyond performance with Intel® Core™ processors
Intel® Core™ processors feature newly optimized hybrid architecture and industry-leading technology that enables you to go beyond gaming and creation. With Intel, you can do it all. From progressing in-game to advancing in real life, Intel empowers you to be your best self.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built for the era of AI, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the NVIDIA suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
Enjoy 3 months of Xbox Game Pass on Lenovo Legion devices
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new Lenovo Legion laptop and three months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with a connected controller. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms
Smarter gaming. Higher framerates. Lenovo AI Engine+.
The Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 gaming laptop is an esports beast, powered by the revolutionary LA-2Q + LA1 AI chip and Lenovo AI Engine+, making it smarter than ever.  In real-time, Lenovo AI Engine+ deploys a Smart Engine to optimize your game for maximum FPS by leveraging a host of system sensors across key components.  Further, Smart Engine gets better over time, ensuring your system can reach maximum performance to stay ahead of the competition, in and out of the arena, from the moment you unbox and for years to come.
Legion ColdFront: Vapor—Best-in-class thermal technology
Elevate your game with Legion ColdFront: Vapor’s AI augmentation, offering top-tier thermal technology for optimal performance in the esports arena.  The enhanced fan system with ultra-thin 3D fan blades ensures silent and smooth operation. A large intake and exhaust system optimizes airflow, boosting thermal efficiency for power-hungry games and software. It also features a colossal vapor chamber and GPU hybrid heat pipe tech. Infusion prevents throttling, keeping CPUs cool.
Display greatness
Quick-scope your enemies into oblivion on the cutting-edge Lenovo PureSight Gaming display, now X-Rite™ Pantone® Certified and factory-calibrated for incredible color accuracy. With a high 240hz variable refresh rate, this 16″ WQXGA 16:10 aspect ratio display makes the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 laptop perfect for big picture, fast reflexes, and accurate aim. The screen takes up 93.59% of the display's surface area, making it look like your picture is floating in space. Plus, 100% DCI-P3, HDR, and high color accuracy let you see every detail of your game, no matter how bright or dark the in-game environment gets.
Seize the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage allows you to optimize settings elevating your gaming experience. You can adjust, customize, and maximize your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls and AI-performance tuning with intelligent fan controls so nothing stands in the way of your success.
Play for the Green Team
Game responsibly with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9. Made from 50% recycled aluminum for the D cover, and 30% PCC for the A cover frame, this laptop is clean, environmentally and visually. The environmental ambient RGB lighting strip with AI light sync via Legion Spectrum makes it easy to customize your vibe and reacts to what's happening on your screen. Plus, a rear dashboard with full I/O support gives you all the connectivity you need.
Maxed out power
Enjoy unparalleled battery power with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 laptop. This bad boy is equipped with a 99.99Whr battery, the largest battery we can legally put into a laptop! Super Rapid Charge ensures the monster battery recharges in minutes with a 330W DC charger in the box and additional support for 140W USB-C* charging for on-the-go lifestyles. Additionally, Smart Battery v3.0 uses machine learning to preserve the battery's capacity and reduce deterioration.
*140W USB-C AC adapter sold separately
Control the battle
The Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 boasts the Legion TrueStrike gaming keyboard, the perfect set of controls for gamers who demand precision control—and great customization options. This full-sized keyboard also features full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large mylar touchpad that gives you everything you need to dominate. Fully customizable per-key RGB powered by Legion Spectrum gives you the power to create a stellar ambiance while you game. Plus, with 1.5mm key travel and support for swappable keycaps, you can create the perfect setup for your play style.
Immersive gaming with Tobii
Take control of the game using your head movements and experience a seamless expansion of your field of view. Tobii Horizon detects and tracks natural head movements via the built-in webcam. Additionally, get immersed in a new era of digital well-being with Tobii Aware for increased security, privacy, and productivity via smart features like auto-dimming, screen time tracking, privacy notifications, and auto-locking.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers, immersive 3D Audio
Experience gaming on a new level with Nahimic by SteelSeries on the Legion Pro 7i. Designed specifically for gamers, it delivers immersive 3D audio that enhances your in-game journey. Communicate with your teammates in crystal-clear quality or mix and share audio streams like a professional. Nahimic doesn't just enhance your gaming—it immerses you in it.
Legion Arena, the ultimate gaming hub
Your games are all in one place. Legion Arena’s centralized gaming hub easily syncs with popular stores and gaming platforms to give you complete control over how you play, browse and manage your game library. You can access all your games in one place, no more switching between apps to find your favorite games.

Special 30th Anniversary Edition
October marks 30 years of ThinkPad and we’re commemorating this monumental occasion with a special, limited run of ThinkPad X1 Carbon 30th Anniversary Edition laptops! The special edition includes the classic ThinkPad logo in red, green, and blue (RGB). What’s more, it’s branded with a 30th Anniversary Edition etching just below the keyboard. Plus, commemorative serial numbers are engraved on the right hinge cap, starting at 0001.
Commemorative packaging & extras
To further mark the celebration, the packaging on the special edition is remarkable as well. Not only is it 100% compostable and engineered from rapid-renewable bamboo sugarcane fiber, but it also includes a specially labeled paper band on the outside. Inside, you’ll find a History of ThinkPad leaflet and ThinkPad X1 logo stickers in the classic red, green, and blue. The pièce de résistance, however, is the package of RGB TrackPoint caps—so you can make your ThinkPad as unique as you and swap out your color whenever you want.
The Bottom Line
"A 12th Gen Intel CPU, a sharper webcam, and more display options cement the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon's place as the finest laptop for business—and likely the finest laptop, period." Source: PCMag.com
Serious productivity enhancer
Powered by Intel vPro®, An Intel® Evo™ Design—with up to 14 cores—our legendary ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 laptop takes multitasking to the next level. These CPUs have a revolutionary design that intelligently allocates workloads to the right thread, on the right core, at the right time—which allows for better video collaboration and productivity based on how you’re using your device.
Communication just got a lot nicer
Say hello to the Communications Bar, a gorgeous new design that houses the higher resolution FHD camera with optional infrared (IR) and Computer Vision features—all with a webcam privacy shutter. It also shows off the 4 x 360-degree mics with integrated AI-based noise-cancellation and Dolby Voice®. The Communications Bar not only looks great—it inspires seamless collaboration and vibrant video calls.
Keeps cool under pressure
The underside of the keys on our legendary ThinkPad keyboard has been redesigned for air intake to create better airflow. Combined with the dual fan and rear venting, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 laptop delivers improved thermals—so go ahead and put in long hours working and playing as this X1 will stay as cool as you are.
Missing laptop? No problem.
If you misplace your laptop, or worse, if someone takes it, locating your device has never been so easy. Now Tile® ready, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 works with your smartphone to find your device—even when your X1 is powered off. Simply subscribe to the Tile® service*, and then download, set up, and activate.
* Subscription not included and must be purchased separately.
Security as unique as your DNA
Biometrics provides extra security on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 laptop—from the power button integrated with the fingerprint reader that lets you log in and boot up instantaneously to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. Plus, Computer Vision-based presence detection automatically locks your device when you move away, and with the optional PrivacyGuard display, no wandering eyes see what’s on your screen.
Displays that dazzle
Whether your position requires richly detailed graphical displays or extra security to keep spying eyes away, the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 laptop has an option for you. Ranging from 4K WQUXGA touch to 2.8K OLED, WUXGA, and even ePrivacy, all 14" panels feature a 16:10 aspect ratio with narrow bezels. Most displays also include low-power usage and Eyesafe® certification to reduce blue-light emissions.
Count on ThinkPad every time
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Business on a budget?
Consider a ﬂexible approach to IT procurement, Lenovo Device as a Service (DaaS). Designed to free up time and capital, it combines devices, service support, and software into fixed monthly payments. And by taking care of lifecycle management enables your IT resources to focus on what they do best.

product_description:
ASUS Announces All-New Zenbook 14 OLED (UX3405)
TAIPEI, Taiwan, December 14, 2023 — ASUS today announced the all-new Zenbook 14 OLED (UX3405), a premium ultraportable laptop. 
The sleek Zenbook 14 OLED is the ultimate Intel® Evo™ Edition ultraportable laptop that takes sophistication to a whole new level. Users can seize every moment using the enhanced, extended-life 75 Wh battery, amplify their efficiency with up to the top-tier Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 processor and Intel Arc™ graphics1, and achieve seamless connectivity via all the essential I/O ports — including two Thunderbolt™ 4, USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, HDMI® 2.1 (TMDS) and a 3.5 mm audio jack. 
An immersive audiovisual experience is provided by the vivid 3K ASUS Lumina OLED 120 Hz touchscreen2 and powerful new super-linear speakers, and the user-friendly design incorporates convenient face login, an FHD IR camera with a physical shutter for privacy, and a new quiet ASUS ErgoSense keyboard. 
The new design offers improved sustainability with the extensive use of recycled materials for the laptop and its packaging, and US military-grade durability testing maximizes the device's service life.
Zenbook 14 OLED delivers uncompromising mobility with its sleek, lightweight and sturdy all-metal design and enhanced-lifespan 75 Wh battery. At just 14.9 mm thin and weighing only 1.2 kg3, the elegant chassis is around 10% more compact than the previous generation. 
The specially designed battery supports up to 20% more charging cycles4 than previous models, protecting the user's investment and helping to maximize the laptop's life. It also offers up to 15 hours5 of unplugged operation for all-day productivity. USB-C® Easy Charge makes it simple to recharge from any suitable USB-C adapter, power outlet or power bank. 
Zenbook 14 OLED is an Intel Evo Edition laptop that features top-tier AI-powered Intel Core Ultra processors with built-in Intel Arc graphics. Intel Core Ultra processors include a dedicated engine to help unlock AI experiences, deliver the next level in immersive graphics, and enable high-performance low-power processing, so users can work, game and create while enjoying long battery life. Combined with the laptop's ultrafast up to 1 TB SSD storage, 32 GB RAM and WiFi 6E (802.11ax)6, this means that users will wait less and be able work faster, wherever they are.
The ultra-vivid 3K (2880x1800) ASUS Lumina OLED 120 Hz display makes every moment incredible, with its up to 600-nit brightness, web-friendly 16:10 aspect ratio, and 87% screen-to-body ratio. And adaptive sync automatically adjusts the refresh rate for always-smooth visuals. 
Despite its ultra-compact form factor, Zenbook 14 OLED includes a comprehensive set of full-size high-speed I/O ports — including two Thunderbolt 4 ports, USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, HDMI 2.1 (TMDS) and a convenient 3.5 mm audio jack — so users don't need to carry dongles or adapters around with them.
Zenbook 14 OLED is designed with the user firmly in mind, incorporating a range of advanced features designed to enhance their mobile lifestyle. Whatever the user is listening to, the powerful, crystal-clear sound delivered by the new super-linear speakers, smart amplifier and ASUS Audio Booster in the Harman Kardon-certified audio system will give their ears a treat with the multidimensional Dolby Atmos® sound. 
When late-night deadlines approach, the new quiet ASUS ErgoSense keyboard reduces aural distractions to a minimum while offering a supremely comfortable typing experience, thanks to the fine-tuned key pitch, dished key caps and ergonomic key travel. 
To guard the user's privacy, the FHD IR camera has a physical shutter, and the camera delivers a superlative video conferencing experience, enhanced by AI noise cancelation and built-in video enhancements for crystal-clear audio and crisp video.     
ASUS is committed to do more with less through Zenbook. This device aims to minimize its environmental impact across the entire product lifecycle, from material use and manufacturing, through to assembly, use, and end of life. We have mitigated its carbon footprint by incorporating up to 50% post-consumer-recycled (PCR) materials and designing eco-conscious packaging that's 100% recyclable. Zenbook 14 OLED also exceeds the ENERGY STAR® power-efficiency standard by 50%. 
To maximize the lifespan of the laptop — and hence improve sustainability — strict US military-grade testing under a stringent test regime ensures outstanding durability.

The Dolby Atmos® Speaker System on the ThinkPad X1 Nano laptop includes two upward-firing tweeters and two downward-firing woofers—this creates an immersive sound experience you’ll enjoy for work and for play. Engineered for a future of universal 5G technology, the ThinkPad X1 Nano laptop offers a true smartphone-like experience in an always-connected PC. Speedy WiFi 6 lets you jump on crowded public platforms fast. Stay connected to what matters most, no matter where you are.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.

All-day battery life keeps you unplugged, but when you need more juice, Rapid Charge delivers 0-80% in just an hour. What’s more, with just the touch of a button, you can easily answer, make, and disconnect from conference calls by using the F9-F11 function keys.
The ThinkPad X1 Nano keeps your data and your device protected through an updated suite of built-in ThinkShield security solutions, as well as truly innovative AI and biometric security features. These range from the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM), which encrypts data—making it more difficult to hack—to the extra-secure match-on-chip fingerprint reader. Human-presence detection automatically locks your device when you move away, and in combination with the IR camera, it enables zero-touch login even from sleep.
ThinkPad laptops are tested against 12 military-grade requirements and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. From the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms, from zero-gravity to spills and drops, you can trust these laptops to handle whatever life throws your way.

product_name: Lenovo NEW ThinkPad Edge E14 Gen5 Intel Core i7 13Gen 10-Core w/SSD Gen 4.0 & IPS 300nits Display
product_description:
Designed for business performance
The Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 (14″ Intel) laptop is powerful, durable, and secure, to help you excel at your daily business needs. It’s designed for data tabulation, quick design projects, research, and reviewing content. Equipped with an Intel® Core™ processor, onboard Intel® integrated graphics, and extensive memory and SSD storage, the E14 Gen 5 delivers fast, powerful performance.
Enjoy your work experience
The color options give the ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 (14″ Intel) laptop a contemporary, professional look. The new keyboard design gives an enhanced feel, for smoother, error-free inputs. Its 115mm x 56mm trackpad improves onscreen navigation. The ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 also features a crystal-clear 14″ WUXGA display, optional touch, and hardware-based Low Blue Light certification for an exceptional visual experience.
Connect to anything and anyone
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 (14″ Intel) laptop houses all the ports needed for peripherals and better collaboration, including USB-C 3.2, USB-A 3.2 and 2.0, and Thunderbolt™ 4. Connect wirelessly hassle-free with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth® 5.0, and rely on dual mics and a choice of an HD, FHD, or hybrid FHD + IR webcam (with privacy shutter) for efficient, effective collaboration.
Smart security
Protect your laptop and your data with options like a discrete trusted platform module (dTPM) 2.0, optional FHD hybrid IR camera required for Windows Hello, and Smart Power On. The dTPM 2.0 secure chip encrypts your passwords and other sensitive data, while only you can access your laptop via the FHD hybrid IR camera or the optional fingerprint reader on the Power On button.
Tough enough to take anywhere
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 (14″ Intel) clears the U.S. Department of Defense’s MIL-STD 810H standards for reliability as well as durability, and the laptop’s optional sturdy metal cover protects your device from bumps and spills wherever you are. Tested against 12 stringent standards and more than 200 quality checks, this laptop will run in even the harshest of conditions, from the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms.

Whether you need this for work, school or on the road; Alpha-BP backpack can handle it. With huge capacity, there is plenty of room for all your necessities and much more. With multiple compartments inside and exterior pockets; the storage is never-ending.
This lightweight bag features a main compartment which houses a dedicated area for your laptop (up to 15.6”). The Promate Alpha-BP is the ultimate gear bag with simple compartment within the interior, exterior and two external side pockets on either side. An additional full-size easy access pocket on the front.

Power, speed, & convenience
Powered by up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processing, the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop boasts high performance and blazing-fast memory, storage, and connectivity—it will zip through even your most demanding tasks. IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability, while everyone can get behind the added security with Intel vPro®.
Environmentally responsible
While the lightweight chassis is so convenient to carry around, it’s the sustainable materials that make owning this machine a true delight. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop is composed of 90% recycled magnesium on the C frame, and for the Storm Grey models, there’s 55% recycled aluminum on the D cover. Along with post-consumer content, recycled plastic in the enclosures for the speaker and battery, and the AC adapter, the packaging is plastic-free with 90% recycled and/or sustainable materials. Plus, the manufacturing process uses low-temperature soldering.
Easy on the eyes
If you spend hours on your laptop every day, you’ll need one that’s easy on the eyes. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 boasts a number of display options, ranging from a gorgeous 2.8K OLED with Dolby Vision® panel to lower resolution choices that offer touchscreens, PrivacyGuard, and various color gamuts. Plus, most of the displays feature low blue light certifications to help prevent eye fatigue. And with narrower bezels and a high screen-to-body ratio, everyone’s sure to appreciate the added screen real estate on this device.
Unleash your productivity
When you’re out on the road, you never know what the connectivity situation will be, or whether you’ll find an available electrical outlet. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop definitely keeps you covered in both regards! Lightning-quick WiFi keeps you online when wireless coverage is available—but if you’re out of range, you can also jump online just like a smartphone when you choose the WWAN* configuration.  What’s more, with the option of two battery sizes and rapid-charging technology, there’s little need to be tethered to an outlet. No matter where the business takes you, you’ll always be business-ready.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
Military-grade durability
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Security solutions tailored to you
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop— from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. Human-presence detection works with the infrared camera to automatically lock your device when you move away. And Intel vPro® helps prevent attacks on the OS, login credentials, and more.

Secure the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage helps you optimize settings to elevate your gaming experience. You can adjust, customize, and maximize your laptop’s capabilities through our all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking controls, and AI-performance tuning with intelligent fan controls, nothing stands in the way of your success.
Game sustainably

The rear I/O dashboard provides all the connectivity you need, streamlining and simplifying your everyday experiences. And with Lenovo's CO2 Carbon Offset Service, you can take an active role in reducing your device's carbon footprint, making it easy for you to be environmentally conscious.
The power to perform
Unleash unrivaled power with the Legion Pro 5i laptop and its massive 80Wh battery. Play, work, and stream all day with confidence. Super Rapid Charge technology ensures your battery recharges in minutes with optional 140W USB-C charger*. The Smart Battery feature uses machine learning to preserve the battery's capacity and reduce deterioration, extending the battery life and maximizing your laptop's lifetime.
*Laptops include 230W or 300W power adapter.  Optional 140W USB-C power adapter sold separately.
Precision meets performance
The Legion Pro 5i is equipped with the Legion TrueStrike gaming keyboard for gamers who demand precision controls. Customize your gameplay to suit your style with next-level customizations and fully optimized controls. The keyboard features full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large Mylar touchpad for everything you need to dominate your opponents. With 1.5mm key travel, swappable keycaps, and 4-zone RGB powered by Legion Spectrum, you can create the perfect setup for your play style.
Maximize your in-game awareness
Tobii Horizon is a cutting-edge gearless head-tracking software that allows you to experience a new level of immersion in an epic selection of games and game franchises. Beyond gaming, welcome to a new era of smart features that enable you to increase your privacy, security, productivity, and wellbeing with Tobii Aware.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers
Elevate your gaming experience with Nahimic by SteelSeries, designed specifically for gamers. Enjoy unparalleled immersive 3D audio and crystal-clear communication with your teammates. With the ability to mix and share audio streaming like a pro, Nahimic allows you to fully immerse yourself in your games and truly live them.

With one point of contact, get 24/7 gamer-centric support from a team of IT and gaming experts who can help optimize your hardware and software settings. Legion Ultimate Support pros will keep you productive all day and unbeatable at night.

You can access all your games in one place, without switching between apps to find your favorite games.

product_name: Lenovo NEW ThinkPad Edge E16 Gen1 Intel Core i5 13Gen 10-Core w/ FHD WebCam & SSD Gen 4.0 & Nvidia Graphic
product_description:
Ready to make the most of your day
The Lenovo ThinkPad E16 (16″ Intel) laptop exudes power, reliable performance, and robust security—for all of your business requirements. It’s designed to handle heavy loads of work and is perfect for data tabulation, quick design works, research, and reviewing content. Equipped with up to a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i7 processor, integrated UMA graphics, extensive memory and SSD storage, the E16 delivers blazing-fast performance.
Enjoy an elevated work experience
The stunning Graphite Black color gives the ThinkPad E16 (16″ Intel) laptop a modern, professional look. Its keyboard houses robust keys with better key spacing, to prevent accidental input, plus a number pad. The smooth 115mm x 68mm trackpad improves onscreen navigation. The ThinkPad E16 also features a crystal-clear 16” WUXGA display, optional touch, and hardware-based Low Blue Light certification for an excellent visual experience.
Get connected & stay connected
More connectivity means more effective working. The ThinkPad E16 comes with all the ports needed for peripherals and better collaboration, including USB-C 3.2, USB-A 3.2 and 2.0, and Thunderbolt™ 4, to name a few. Connect wirelessly hassle-free with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth® 5.0, and rely on dual mics and a choice of an HD, FHD, or hybrid FHD + IR webcam (with privacy shutter) for collaboration.
Options to keep your data safe
Protect your laptop and your data with options like a discrete trusted platform module (dTPM) 2.0, optional hybrid FHD + IR camera required for Windows Hello, and Smart Power On. The dTPM 2.0 secure chip encrypts your passwords and other sensitive data, while only you can access your laptop via the optional fingerprint reader on the Power On button or the FHD hybrid IR camera.
Tough enough to take anywhere
The ThinkPad E16 laptop is a good fit for remote work, thanks to its portable design and high battery capacity. It clears the U.S. Department of Defense’s MIL-STD 810H standards for reliability and durability, and the laptop’s optional sturdy metal cover protects your devices form bumps and spills wherever you are. Tested against 12 stringent standards and more than 200 quality checks, the ThinkPad E16 laptop will run in even the harshest of conditions, from the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms.

Power, speed, & convenience
Powered by up to Intel vPro® with 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processing, the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop boasts high performance and blazing-fast memory, storage, and connectivity—it will zip through even your most demanding tasks. IT admins appreciate the convenience of remote deployment and manageability, while everyone can get behind the added security with Intel vPro®.
Environmentally responsible
While the lightweight chassis is so convenient to carry around, it’s the sustainable materials that make owning this machine a true delight. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop is composed of 90% recycled magnesium on the C frame, and for the Storm Grey models, there’s 55% recycled aluminum on the D cover. Along with post-consumer content, recycled plastic in the enclosures for the speaker and battery, and the AC adapter, the packaging is plastic-free with 90% recycled and/or sustainable materials. Plus, the manufacturing process uses low-temperature soldering.
Easy on the eyes
If you spend hours on your laptop every day, you’ll need one that’s easy on the eyes. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 boasts a number of display options, ranging from a gorgeous 2.8K OLED with Dolby Vision® panel to lower resolution choices that offer touchscreens, PrivacyGuard, and various color gamuts. Plus, most of the displays feature low blue light certifications to help prevent eye fatigue. And with narrower bezels and a high screen-to-body ratio, everyone’s sure to appreciate the added screen real estate on this device.
Unleash your productivity
When you’re out on the road, you never know what the connectivity situation will be, or whether you’ll find an available electrical outlet. The ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop definitely keeps you covered in both regards! Lightning-quick WiFi keeps you online when wireless coverage is available—but if you’re out of range, you can also jump online just like a smartphone when you choose the WWAN* configuration.  What’s more, with the option of two battery sizes and rapid-charging technology, there’s little need to be tethered to an outlet. No matter where the business takes you, you’ll always be business-ready.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
Military-grade durability
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Security solutions tailored to you
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 laptop— from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to our laptops. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. Human-presence detection works with the infrared camera to automatically lock your device when you move away. And Intel vPro® helps prevent attacks on the OS, login credentials, and more.

Lean, mean, & green

RISE TO THE LEVEL OF THE CHALLENGE
Take advantage of Ryzen's power with the AMD Ryzen processor. This flagship processor has incredible single-threaded performance, which is essential for a smooth gaming experience. No matter how you plan to play, the AMD Ryzen processor is there to support you.
THE NEXT GENERATION
DDR5 is here! State-of-the-art memory technology records data 50% faster than DDR4, with the new Strix G offering 4800MHz RAM, making most DDR4 laptops fun. Higher bandwidth and higher frequencies ensure that your CPU will never wait.
ELIMINATION OF CHARGING TIME
Nobody likes to wait. With PCIe® 4.0, you'll be in the middle of nowhere faster than ever. Every time you upload a new mission, install the latest game in the library, or work with file transfers and massive projects, PCIe® 4.0 has more than enough bandwidth to maintain optimal machine performance.
MUX SWITCH INCREASES GRAPHIC PERFORMANCE
Top components require power, especially when it comes to the latest video cards. Higher power limits unleash even higher performance for these graphics cards, ensuring you have the best gaming experience possible.
Modern gaming laptops direct GPU footage through integrated CPU graphics before reaching the screen. This provides better battery life, but prevents the GPU from providing the best performance. So we've implemented MUX switches for all ROG 2022 laptops. For competitive gaming, you can switch to direct GPU mode, which reduces latency and increases performance by an average of 15%.

INCREASES PRODUCTIVITY WITH AI

product_name: Lenovo ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 (2023) NEW 13Gen Intel Core i7 14-Cores w/ RTX 4060 Impressive Performance Business Class
product_description:
Creativity translator
The Lenovo ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop is ideal for creative professionals and businesses. Powered by 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, the 16p boasts high performance, and blazing-fast memory, storage, and connectivity. Add to that NVIDIA® GeForce RTX® graphics, and you’re ready to master whatever workloads hit your desk. Enhanced thermals with a dual-fan design and four vents keep airflow circulating to ensure the system runs cool.
Creature comforts
Along with the sleek look and feel of the aluminum chassis, the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop boasts an upgraded ergonomically redesigned keyboard. With an integrated smart backlight, the ambient light sensor automatically adjusts the amount of light needed so even working in dimly lit places won’t deter your productivity. The touchpad is much larger than previous generations, and it’s made with a glass surface—so navigating feels smooth and easy.
Take your online meetings to the next level
When it comes to virtual collaboration, the Lenovo Magic Bay optional suite of modular accessories enhance your experience. Made exclusively for the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop, each of these pocket-sized devices magnetically attaches to the top of the display and via a pogo-pin. Lenovo Magic Bay LTE ensures 4G access as long as there’s mobile coverage*. The 4K Webcam with 30FPS, autofocus, autoframing, and adjustable viewing angles captures you at your best. And the Magic Bay Light illuminates any dim area and even powers on automatically when the laptop’s camera turns on.
*Availability varies by region and requires a network service provider.
Respects the planet
The ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop sports a series of sustainability certifications such as EPEAT® Gold (select countries), ENERGY STAR® 8.0, and TCO 9—the world-leading environmental certification for IT products. Sustainably sourced packaging is certified by the Forest Stewardship Council® (FSC). You can even decrease your carbon footprint with the Lenovo CO2 Offset Service. But the best part, perhaps, is that various components are made from post-consumer content, with 50% recycled aluminum on the keyboard frame (C side) and 30% recycled plastic on the AC adapter.
24/7 security
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop— from the fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the IR camera. ThinkShield, our comprehensive suite of security solutions, is integral to ensuring your system is protected. Features like discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) encrypt your data. There’s even a self-healing BIOS should it become corrupted.
When every pixel matters
The ThinkBook 16p Gen 4 laptop features amazing display options up to a 3.2K 3200 x 2000 resolution that also includes X-Rite® Factory Display Calibration and 100% DCI-P3 color gamut. Vibrant and rich visuals render true to life with Dolby Vision® whether your editing videos or creating multimedia. What’s more, TÜV Eyesafe® low blue light certification means that even when working long hours, the likelihood of eye fatigue or strain is significantly decreased.
Specifications may vary depending upon region / model.

product_description:
360 degrees of adaptability
Create, play and work on a device that adapts to whatever you're doing with 360 degrees of freedom on the convertible Lenovo Flex 7i. Rotate the hinge into tent or stand modes to watch your shows or switch to tablet mode to browse through as you hold the ultrathin-and-light Stone Blue chassis that slims down to 17.4mm and weighs just 1.5kg. Rugged and ergonomic, the drop-down hinge has been durability tested 25,000 times, gently lifting the keyboard to cover the display's bottom bezel and afford users a more comfortable typing angle and larger screen ratio.
Soak in the photorealistic color
Experience stunning realistic color, sharp contrast and vivid detail with an up-to-2.2K 14" display that features 100% sRGB color gamut for enhanced photorealism and 300 nits brightness for easier outdoors viewing. Cut down on eye strain with TUV certification and elevate your visual field with a taller 16:10 display sporting narrow bezels on all sides and a drop-down hinge for a greater-than-90% screen-to-body ratio.
Break new performance barriers
Break your creativity, gaming, streaming and productivity barriers with the Intel® Evo™-certified Lenovo Flex 7i, featuring 12th Generation Intel Core™ processors for real-world multitasking and performance that scales up as your workload intensifies. Video chat, game or edit 3D videos--your system keeps cool and quiet under heavy loads thanks to its Intelligent Cooling fan system, which optimizes for Quiet, Balance and Performance--depending on your needs. And up to 1TB PCIe SSD offers near-limitless storage at blazing speeds.
Start, charge and connect faster
Do things faster, better and at a lower latency with two hours of battery life on a 15-minute charge via rapid-charge boost, secure and effortless log-in with a fingerprint sensor and Wi-Fi 6E, offering dedicated high-speed channels and no legacy Wi-Fi interference for seamless videoconferencing, cloud gaming and other real-time applications. Access universal cable connectivity from Type-C port charging and Thunderbolt 4.0, which can connect multiple devices such as two 4K monitors while delivering 40Gbps bi-directional bandwidth. Draw and note naturally with the Lenovo E-Color pen with 4,096 levels of pressure sensitivity, three shortcut buttons and compatibility with Adobe Suite and Wacom Bamboo Paper.

product_description:
Responsive experience
With the Intel® Evo™ platform*, the ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 laptop delivers a powerhouse combination of performance, responsiveness, battery life, and stunning visuals. With up to 11th Gen Intel® Core™ i7 vPro® processors, you can count on an exceptional experience, anywhere.
*Intel® Core™ i5 and i7 models only
Updated design
The ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 features several design enhancements over its previous generation—for comfort, convenience, and aesthetics. Thinner top and bottom bezels leave more space for the gorgeous new 16:10 display. A wider touchpad yields greater control. The optional Storm Gray aluminum model includes a tone-matched keyboard, for a striking look. Lastly, the power button with optional fingerprint reader allows for quick, one-touch login.
Speed & power
This laptop’s 11th Gen Intel® Core™ processor with Iris® Xe graphics* means business, yielding blazing-fast performance, industry-leading AI, and the best WiFi 6 experience. Enhance productivity with speedy PCIe SSD storage, plus up to 32GB of LPDDR4x memory. Dual Thunderbolt™ 4 ports offer quick data transfer and more accessory productivity options.
*Intel® Core™ i5 and i7 models only
Ultimate mobility
Starting at 1.27kg / 2.78lbs and 18mm / 0.7", the X13 Gen 2 PC is easy to take anywhere, whether it be a different room while working from home or some other remote location. Stay connected with ease featuring all-day battery life, and rapid-charging technology in case you need a quick boost.
Constant connectivity
The ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 gives you options to stay better-connected—to the internet and accessories. It’s enabled for WiFi 6E—a faster, more efficient version of WiFi. Modern Standby wakes your laptop in one second and connects online one second later. Or choose the optional 5G capability, for connectivity wherever cellular service is available*. Dual Thunderbolt™ 4 ports yield fast data transfer and connections to multiple accessories.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
Ultimate mobility
This PC’s 16:10 display is stunning in up to WQXGA resolution, with 100% sRGB color gamut. Optional blue light reduction makes it even easier on your eyes. Its front-facing Dolby Audio™ Speaker System, optional FHD infrared camera, and two far field microphones, make videoconferences clear and easy.
Protects your data & your privacy
Protect your data and yourself with enhanced ThinkShield features like a physical shutter for the webcam and an improved PrivacyGuard* with PrivacyAlert screen that helps prevent nosy neighbors from reading your screen. Log in securely via the match-on-chip fingerprint reader* on the power button, let the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 chip encrypt your data, and rest easy with human presence detection (HPD)*, which allows zero-touch login with Windows Hello and locks your laptop when you leave.*Optional / select models

product_description:
Built to perform
ThinkPad L14 Gen 2 laptop packs a solid punch with up to 11th Gen Intel® Core™ i7 processors, up to 64GB DDR4 (3200MHz) memory, up to 512GB SSD, and up to 2TB HDD storage. Combine all this with professional graphics, and you have a device that transitions easily from work to play.
Works even when asleep
Enjoy time-saving features that return minutes to your busy day. The ThinkPad L14 Gen 2 laptop offers Modern Standby, which enables the system to wake and connect to the internet instantaneously. Plus, it keeps email and select apps synced even when the device is asleep, ensuring instant productivity upon waking.
Always connected
With the second generation of the ThinkPad L14 PC, it’s even easier to stay connected—whether to devices or the internet. The Thunderbolt™ 4 port transfers data super-fast, while the HDMI 2.0 port conveniently hooks up to a monitor. Speedy WiFi 6 lets you jump on crowded public platforms while avoiding lag-time and buffering. And with the optional 4G WWAN*, you can enjoy fast and secure access to your network and uninterrupted video streaming even when WiFi is out of range.
*Coming Soon: Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
One-touch calling & great audio
When you need to make calls, the dual-array mics and the Dolby® Premium app on the ThinkPad L14 Gen 2 cancel background noise to deliver a fine-tuned call experience. Plus, with just the touch of a button, ThinkPad L14 laptop lets you easily answer, make, and disconnect from conference calls with the F9-F11 function keys. Enjoy one-touch calling and simplify your workday.
Seamless security
The ThinkPad L14 Gen 2 protects your data and your device with an updated suite of built-in ThinkShield security solutions, as well as biometric security features. These range from the optional match-on-chip fingerprint reader to the discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM), which encrypts data—making it more difficult to hack. Plus, the standard webcam privacy shutter ensures your camera stays off when you want it to.
Military-grade testing
ThinkPad laptops are tested against 12 military-grade requirements and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. From the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms, from zero-gravity to spills and drops, you can trust these laptops to handle whatever life throws your way.

product_description:
Responsive experience
With the Intel® Evo™ platform*, the ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 laptop delivers a powerhouse combination of performance, responsiveness, battery life, and stunning visuals. With up to 11th Gen Intel® Core™ i7 vPro® processors, you can count on an exceptional experience, anywhere.
*Intel® Core™ i5 and i7 models only
Updated design
The ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 features several design enhancements over its previous generation—for comfort, convenience, and aesthetics. Thinner top and bottom bezels leave more space for the gorgeous new 16:10 display. A wider touchpad yields greater control. The optional Storm Gray aluminum model includes a tone-matched keyboard, for a striking look. Lastly, the power button with optional fingerprint reader allows for quick, one-touch login.
Speed & power
This laptop’s 11th Gen Intel® Core™ processor with Iris® Xe graphics* means business, yielding blazing-fast performance, industry-leading AI, and the best WiFi 6 experience. Enhance productivity with speedy PCIe SSD storage, plus up to 32GB of LPDDR4x memory. Dual Thunderbolt™ 4 ports offer quick data transfer and more accessory productivity options.
*Intel® Core™ i5 and i7 models only
Ultimate mobility
Starting at 1.27kg / 2.78lbs and 18mm / 0.7", the X13 Gen 2 PC is easy to take anywhere, whether it be a different room while working from home or some other remote location. Stay connected with ease featuring all-day battery life, and rapid-charging technology in case you need a quick boost.
Constant connectivity
The ThinkPad X13 Gen 2 gives you options to stay better-connected—to the internet and accessories. It’s enabled for WiFi 6E—a faster, more efficient version of WiFi. Modern Standby wakes your laptop in one second and connects online one second later. Or choose the optional 5G capability, for connectivity wherever cellular service is available*. Dual Thunderbolt™ 4 ports yield fast data transfer and connections to multiple accessories.
* Optional WWAN availability varies by region and must be configured at time of purchase; it requires a network service provider.
Ultimate mobility
This PC’s 16:10 display is stunning in up to WQXGA resolution, with 100% sRGB color gamut. Optional blue light reduction makes it even easier on your eyes. Its front-facing Dolby Audio™ Speaker System, optional FHD infrared camera, and two far field microphones, make videoconferences clear and easy.
Protects your data & your privacy
Protect your data and yourself with enhanced ThinkShield features like a physical shutter for the webcam and an improved PrivacyGuard* with PrivacyAlert screen that helps prevent nosy neighbors from reading your screen. Log in securely via the match-on-chip fingerprint reader* on the power button, let the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 chip encrypt your data, and rest easy with human presence detection (HPD)*, which allows zero-touch login with Windows Hello and locks your laptop when you leave.*Optional / select models

Cool Under Pressure. Just Like You
The Lenovo ThinkBook 15 Gen 4 (15" Intel) laptop stays cool under pressure. With up to 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors and optional dual-SSD storage—as big as 1TB—it can handle all your computing needs. Plus, the Intelligent Cooling feature adjusts fan speed, thermal capacity, and battery life to keep the system up and running even under intense use.
Style that's fully functional
Looking for a highly mobile, thin, and sleek laptop? The stylish, dual-tone Lenovo ThinkBook 15 Gen 4 is only 18.9mm / 0.74" thin and starts at just 1.7kg /3.75lbs. Modern Standby wakes the system in just one second upon opening the top cover and connects online one second later. With narrow display bezels and an 88% screen-to-body ratio, you’ll appreciate the larger screen real estate and enjoy the view.
View your work in a new light
With its FHD display, the ThinkBook 15 Gen 4 offers crisp, flicker-free visuals and includes video resolution upscaling to enhance low-res videos. Options include TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light certification to ease eye fatigue and 100% sRGB color gamut models that deliver more accurate, lifelike images. For direct interaction, touchscreen models are available, too.
Teleconference like a pro
AI features on the ThinkBook 15 Gen 4 help keep teleconferences quiet and focused by limiting ambient noise. Multiple settings let you tune your conference audio to your environment.
So many connections
As laptops get smaller, some provide fewer connectivity options. Not Lenovo ThinkBooks, which have all the ports you need. For fast file transfers, the ThinkBook 15 Gen 4 laptop has a Thunderbolt™ 4 port, USB ports, HDMI, and more to connect printers and other peripherals. Plus, speedy WiFi 6E options let you quickly connect to crowded public platforms with little lag-time and buffering.

13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Beyond performance.
Intel®’s latest hybrid architecture paired with industry-leading features delivers the ultimate gaming experience. Stream, create, and compete at the highest levels, as 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors push your gameplay beyond performance, giving you the power to do it all.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs are beyond fast for gamers and creators. They're powered by the ultra-efficient NVIDIA® Ada Lovelace architecture, which delivers a quantum leap in both performance and AI-powered graphics. Experience lifelike virtual worlds with ray tracing, massively boost performance with DLSS 3, and get a competitive edge with Reflex. Discover revolutionary new ways to create and unprecedented workflow acceleration.

Thermal thrust, not throttle
Slimline laptops shouldn’t mean throttled performance. With Lenovo Legion ColdFront 5.0, you can focus on what matters the most – gaming and creating – and not have to worry about your device overheating. The Lenovo Legion Slim 5i is loaded with advanced technologies for quiet and ultra-cool gameplay, such as a phase change thermal compound, much larger hybrid copper heat pipes and fins, increased air intake and exhaust, and a turbo-charged dual liquid crystal polymer fan system.
A synthesis of sleek & sport
Weighing under 2.3kg and measuring as thin as 19.7mm, this powerhouse laptop boasts serious toughness. The perfect balance of strength and style, the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i houses a powerful engine in its sleek chassis, and is available in Storm Grey. With a 1080p webcam with e-shutter, rear I/O dashboard, and SD card reader, this device makes it easy to capture and share your vision.
PureSight, pure power, pure passion
Step up your gaming and content creation visuals with the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i laptop’s 16″ 16:10 WQXGA Lenovo PureSight gaming display. A blazing-fast up-to 165Hz refresh rate and NVIDIA® G-Sync® support makes for smooth, lag-free gameplay. Plus, with X-rite technology on select models, you’ll be able to pick out every detail in stunning clarity. Elevate your display to the next level with a wide color gamut, plenty of screen real estate with 93% AAR, and incredible resolution.
Die-hard battery
The Lenovo Legion Slim 5i packs a whopping up-to 80Whr battery that will keep you fully charged and ready to conquer new worlds in record time. With the Super Rapid Charge technology, get your battery to 70% capacity in just 30 minutes or reach 100% in 80 minutes with the optional 140W USB-C charger. Plus, Smart Battery 3.0 ensures maximum capacity retention and longevity with lifespan predictions, health maintenance, and peak power performance.
*Laptops include a 170W or 230W power adapter.  Optional 140W USB-C power adapter sold separately.
Lenovo AI Engine+ turbocharged by Lenovo LA1 AI chip
Unleash the full potential of your gaming with the unbeatable Lenovo AI Engine+. Equipped with the Lenovo LA1 AI chip, this powerful engine is ready to deliver supercharged gaming. Whether you’re gaming at home or on the go, with the Lenovo Legion Slim 5i, the intelligent and intuitive system features sensors that dynamically allocate wattage between CPU and GPU to optimize performance and minimize fan noise.
Deadly accuracy, pure purpose
Get ready to unleash pure precision and power with the legendary Lenovo Legion TrueStrike keyboard. Engineered with a massive mylar trackpad, numpad, and full-sized arrow keys, this keyboard is crafted for elevated gaming and creative mastery. Its 1.5mm travel distance makes for smooth key presses, while interchangeable keycaps and Legion Spectrum 4-zone RGB keyboard lets you customize your experience to your liking.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for gamers, immersive 3D audio

Plus, liquid metal enhances heat transfer from the CPU. Game green

And supports optional USB-C charging.* At the same time, Smart Battery v3.0 uses machine learning to preserve the battery's capacity and reduce deterioration. Plus, the optional Slim Gallium power adapter is 31% thinner than previous generations—perfect for your on-the-go lifestyle.

Command, control, and strike true

This full-sized keyboard also boasts full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large mylar touchpad that gives you everything you need to dominate. Plus, with 1.5mm key travel and support for optional swappable keycaps* and per-key RGB powered by Legion Spectrum, you can create the perfect setup for your play style.
*Upgrade only available on build your own models
Immersive gaming with Tobii
Take control of the in-game 1080p camera using your head movements and experience a seamless expansion of your field of view. Tobii Horizon detects and tracks natural head movements via the built-in webcam. Superb for productivity & connectivity
With up to AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series Mobile Processors might and up to 40GB of memory, the ThinkPad E15 Gen 4 delivers exceptional performance in one essential business laptop. Plus, the optional WiFi 6E*connectivity will keep you in the loop wherever you are working.
*WiFi 6E requires Windows 11 Pro. Operation is dependent on the support of the operating system, routers/APs/gateways that support WiFi 6E, along with the regional regulatory certifications and spectrum allocation.
Style meets form & function
Thanks to its slim build, choice of aluminum top cover, and an impressive 85% screen-to-body ratio, the stylish ThinkPad E15 Gen 4 looks the part in any business scenario. Weighing from just 1.78kg (3.92lbs) and only 18.9mm (0.74") thin, this laptop can accompany you anywhere. It has an array of ports including USB-C for data, power, video, and audio transfers.
Secure, from the inside out
Log in instantly and securely with just a fingerprint or smile, thanks to the optional built-in fingerprint reader on the power button or through the optional FHD + IR hybrid camera and advanced facial recognition technology. Visually and audibly, the ThinkPad E15 Gen 4 (15" AMD) simply excels. An up to 15.6" FHD antiglare display, with 100% color accuracy, is complemented perfectly by two Harman® speakers and Dolby Audio.
An enhanced all-round user experience
The optional FHD + IR hybrid camera deploys ThinkPad Glance face-, eye-, and gaze-tracking technology for seamless navigation. When you are on a call, two environmental noise-canceling microphones filter out annoying background sounds. And with Microsoft Teams on the Windows 11 taskbar, you can access your contacts, mute/unmute, or share apps with just a click.
Built-in durability & reliability
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for every ThinkPad. Tested against 12 stringent standards, 26 different procedures, and more than 200 quality checks, this business laptop will run in even the harshest conditions, from the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms.

The AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Mobile Series with PRO technologies deliver the enhanced performance and portability required by today’s business professionals. 13th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Beyond performance
 Intel's latest hybrid architecture, paired with industry-leading features, delivers the ultimate gaming experience. Stream, create and compete at the highest levels – 13th Gen Intel Core processors push your gameplay beyond performance, giving you the power to do it all.
Fully powered NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ graphics cards. Beyond fast.
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series GPUs are beyond fast for gamers and creators. They're powered by the ultra-efficient NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture, which delivers a quantum leap in performance and AI-powered graphics. Experience lifelike virtual worlds with ray tracing and ultra-high FPS gaming with the lowest latency. Discover revolutionary new ways to create unprecedented workflow acceleration.
Enjoy 3 months of Xbox Game Pass on Lenovo Legion devices
Play over 100 high-quality games with your new Lenovo Legion laptop and three months of Xbox Game Pass-including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there's always something new to play. Download and play in full fidelity or play console games from the cloud with a connected controller. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms
Credit card required. Unless you cancel, you will be charged the then current regular membership rate when the promotional period ends. Terms, exclusions, and streaming limits apply. Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta): select devices and regions. After term, active membership required to play games and online multiplayer. Game catalog varies over time, region, and by device. DLC sold separately; if a game is removed from catalog or your membership ends, you will need to purchase the game separately to use your DLC. If you’re already an Xbox Live Gold and/or Game Pass for Console/PC member, any days remaining in your membership(s) will be converted to Ultimate using a conversion ratio. Future code redemptions also subject to conversion ratio. All conversions to Ultimate are final. Details and system requirements at www.xbox.com gamepass Offer valid in all Xbox Game Pass markets excluding Russia. Digital Direct: Your digital content will be delivered directly to your device during set up; no codes required.
Smarter gaming for everyone with Lenovo AI Engine+
Powered by the revolutionary LA-2Q AI chip, Lenovo Legion AI Engine+ is smarter than ever. Leveraging a host of system sensors across key components, in real-time, the Lenovo AI Engine+ deploys a Smart Engine to optimize your game for maximum FPS. Further, the Smart Engine gets better over time, ensuring your system can reach maximum performance to stay ahead of the competition in and out of the arena from the moment you unbox and for years to come.
Legion Coldfront 5.0: Best-in-class AI-tuned thermal technology
Best-in-class Legion Coldfront 5.0 thermal technology will keep you competing at your best. The improved fan system with 3D blades as thin as .1mm keeps everything running smoothly. The massive intake and exhaust system keeps air flowing through your device for intense thermal efficiency and performance on power-intensive games and programs. Plus, liquid metal enhances heat transfer from the CPU. With vapor chamber technology for both CPU and/or GPU* and hybrid heat pipe technology, this ensures that you can play sweaty while your laptop stays cool.
*Vapor chamber technology for both CPU and GPU on models with RTX 4080 and RTX 4090 graphics cards.  Other GPU models support vapor chamber technology for CPU only.
Game green
Game responsibly with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 8 (16″ Intel)—our most sustainable device yet. Made from 50% recycled aluminum in the bottom cover and 30% post-consumer recycled polymers on the top cover, this laptop is clean, environmentally and visually. The ambient lighting strip with AI light sync via Legion Spectrum makes it easy to customize your vibe and reacts to what's happening on your screen. Plus, a rear I/O dashboard with full I/O support gives you all the connectivity you need.
A display born to compete
Quick-scope your enemies into oblivion on the cutting-edge Lenovo PureSight Gaming display. With a variable refresh rate, this 16″ WQXGA 16:10 aspect ratio IPS display makes the Legion Pro 7i Gen 8 perfect for big picture, fast reflexes, and accurate aim. The screen takes up 93.6% of the display's surface area, making it look like your picture is floating in space. Plus, HDR and high color accuracy let you see every detail of your game, no matter how bright or dark the in-game environment gets.
Maxed out power
Enjoy unparalleled battery power with the Legion Pro 7i Gen 8 laptop. This bad boy is equipped with a 99.99Whr battery, the largest battery we can legally put into a laptop! Super Rapid Charge ensures the monster battery recharges in minutes. And supports optional USB-C charging.* At the same time, Smart Battery v3.0 uses machine learning to preserve the battery's capacity and reduce deterioration. Plus, the optional Slim Gallium power adapter is 31% thinner than previous generations—perfect for your on-the-go lifestyle.
*USB-C Rapid charging only available in Hybrid charging mode through Lenovo Vantage.
Command, control, and strike true
The Legion Pro 7i Gen 8 boasts the Legion TrueStrike gaming keyboard, the perfect set of controls for gamers who demand precision and great customization options. This full-sized keyboard also boasts full-sized arrow and number pad keys and a large mylar touchpad that gives you everything you need to dominate. Plus, with 1.5mm key travel and support for optional swappable keycaps* and per-key RGB powered by Legion Spectrum, you can create the perfect setup for your play style.
*Upgrade only available on build your own models
Immersive gaming with Tobii
Take control of the in-game 1080p camera using your head movements and experience a seamless expansion of your field of view. Tobii Horizon detects and tracks natural head movements via the built-in webcam. Additionally, get immersed in a new era of digital well-being with Tobii Aware for increased security, privacy, and productivity via smart features like auto-dimming, screen time tracking, privacy notifications, and auto-locking.
Nahimic Audio
Nahimic by SteelSeries drastically improves your gaming experience by providing unprecedented immersive 3D audio designed for gamers specifically. Experience crystal-clear communication with your teammates, allowing you to use a simple way of mixing and sharing audio streaming journeys like a professional streamer. Nahimic doesn't just let you play your games - it lets you live it.
Gain the Lenovo Vantage
Lenovo Vantage helps you optimize settings to elevate your gaming experience. Adjust, customize, and maximize your device capabilities through an all-in-one suite of tools. With our real-time performance dashboard, overclocking control, Legion Spectrum RGB support, and AI performance tuning, nothing stands in the way of your game.

product_description:
Work can take you anywhere, and the second generation of the ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 (Intel) laptop is made to move. At just 1.5kg / 3.5lbs, it’s lightweight and easy to carry. And at just 17.9mm thin, this device slips right into your bag when you’re on the go. What’s more, the anodized aluminum top and bottom covers give it a classy look and feel—choose between our traditional Black or the sleek Mineral Metallic.
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 laptop boasts a cutting-edge 11th Gen Intel® Core™ processor, so you get faster performance to power through your work tasks. Backed by up to 32GB of DDR4 memory and the option of discrete NVIDIA® 450MX graphics, this device confidently handles whatever jobs come your way.
AI-based noise cancellation in the embedded microphone enhances meetings on your ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 laptop. Choose between predefined modes for seamless conferencing—whether at the coffee shop or your home office. Dynamic cooling manages the working temperature for optimum PC performance. And with the low blue-light mode, you can work comfortably for longer.
Visualize better on an engaging display, with full-HD resolution and 100% sRGB color gamut that renders crystal-clear visuals. Choose up to 300 nits of brightness, which means you can see your screen even in outdoor environments. The touchscreen panel lets you intuitively navigate and interact with your E14 Gen 2 laptop.

Modern Standby enables updates while your ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 laptop is sleeping and connects you to the internet instantaneously upon waking. With Smart Power On, you can log in and boot up with one touch. Plus, when making conference calls, you can easily answer, make, and disconnect from calls by using the F9-F11 function keys.
You don’t take chances with your security and neither do we. The E14 Gen 2 laptop includes ThinkShield, a suite of built-in security solutions that keeps your data and your device protected. Trusted Platform Module (TPM) encrypts data, making it more difficult to hack. The optional fingerprint reader and IR camera that works in conjunction with Windows Hello enables near foolproof biometric authentication to prevent unauthorized access to your system.
Optional WiFi 6 lets you jump on crowded public platforms fast and enjoy smooth online experiences with greater bandwidth, stable network connectivity, and lower latency. What’s more, the ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 (Intel) boasts three USB ports, including the industry-leading Intel® Thunderbolt™ 4, which supports up to two independent displays and speeds up file transfers to as much as 40Gbps.
Like all ThinkPad laptops, the E14 Gen 2 is tested against 12 military-grade requirements and more than 200 quality checks. From the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms, from zero-gravity to spills and drops, you can trust these laptops to handle whatever life throws your way.
